title: Note on proliferation transitions of non-Abelian anyons
summary: We study phase transitions out of a (2+1)d topological phase driven by the proliferation of anyons in a braided fusion subcategory. We describe a general theoretical framework for such transitions, in which the topological quantum field theory (TQFT) is coupled to dynamical matter associated with anyons in the subcategory. We interpret this construction using symmetry topological field theory (SymTFT), where the dynamics is localized on the symmetry boundary of the (3+1)d slab. We analyze several examples, and present explicit Chern-Simons-Higgs (CSH) field theories realizing the proliferation transitions. We also examine proliferation transitions that implement gauging of non-invertible one-form symmetry in the parent TQFT. This includes a general construction for ${\rm Rep}(G)$ one-form symmetry for a finite group $G$, and a CSH realization of the non-invertible one-form gauging ${\rm SU}(2)_{10}\rightarrow {\rm Spin}(5)_1$. We discuss which anyons proliferate at these transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了(2+1)维拓扑相中由任意子增殖驱动的相变，提出了一种将拓扑量子场论(TQFT)与子范畴中任意子相关的动力学物质耦合的理论框架，并用对称性拓扑场论(SymTFT)进行解释，通过Chern-Simons-Higgs(CSH)场论具体实现，包括非可逆一形式对称性的规范操作。
AI.motivation: 理解拓扑相中任意子增殖所驱动的相变是拓扑量子场论和凝聚态物理中的重要问题，特别是涉及非可逆对称性规范化的相变缺乏系统的理论框架。
AI.method: 作者提出将TQFT与编织融合子范畴中的任意子所对应的动力学物质耦合，利用SymTFT框架将动力学定域在(3+1)维薄片的对称性边界上，并通过显式的Chern-Simons-Higgs场论实现增殖相变。
AI.result: 给出了多个具体例子，包括Rep(G)一形式对称性的普适构造，以及非可逆一形式规范化SU(2)_10 → Spin(5)_1的CSH实现，并讨论了在这些相变中哪些任意子会发生增殖。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为任意子增殖驱动的拓扑相变提供了统一的理论框架，并通过CSH场论给出了具体实现，特别是为非可逆一形式对称性的规范化提供了新的物理机制。

title: Distinguishing Mott and strain-induced anisotropic semimetals in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene using Landau level spectroscopy
summary: Recent quantum twisting microscopy experiments [1] have provided unprecedented momentum- and energy-resolved imaging of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene, revealing a stark dichotomy between the heavy and light electronic characters of its narrow bands. In this work, we provide a sharp distinguishing criterion between the two most likely candidate states that exhibit spectroscopic features consistent with the experimental results. Focusing on charge neutrality, these states are 1) the 'Mott semimetal', governed by strong dynamical correlations, and 2) the 'strain-induced anisotropic semimetal', characterized by weak Hartree-Fock effects. We demonstrate that an out-of- plane magnetic field serves as a sharp discriminating probe based on the expected Landau level gap size hierarchy. We find that the strain-induced anisotropic semimetal has a robust gap hierarchy where the Chern C gaps, Δ_C , decrease in order Δ_{\pm 4} > Δ_{\pm 8} > Δ_{\pm 12}. In contrast, for the Mott semimetal, Δ_{\pm 4} remains the largest gap, while the relative magnitude of the C = \pm 8, \pm 12 gaps depends sensitively on the applied magnetic field. We test the robustness of these results against strain orientation and lattice relaxation finding consistency between the gap hierarchy of the strained semimetal and previous incompressibility measurements at finite magnetic field [2].

AI.tldr: 本文针对魔角扭曲双层石墨烯的量子扭曲显微镜实验，提出一种基于朗道能级间隙层级（gap hierarchy）的判别标准，用以区分两种可能的光谱状态：强动态关联的"Mott半金属"和弱Hartree-Fock效应的"应变诱导各向异性半金属"。研究发现，垂直磁场下两者展现出不同的Chern间隙层级模式，可作为尖锐的判别探针。
AI.motivation: 量子扭曲显微镜实验揭示了魔角扭曲双层石墨烯窄带中重电子与轻电子特性的显著二分性，但两种最可能的候选态（Mott半金属和应变诱导各向异性半金属）在光谱特征上均与实验一致，需要一种尖锐的判别标准来区分两者。
AI.method: 通过理论计算，分析电荷中性点处两种候选态在垂直外磁场下的朗道能级结构，比较不同Chern数（C = ±4, ±8, ±12）间隙的大小层级关系。该层级关系对磁场、应变取向和晶格弛豫的敏感性也被系统检验。
AI.result: 应变诱导各向异性半金属具有稳健的间隙层级Δ_±4 > Δ_±8 > Δ_±12；而Mott半金属中Δ_±4始终最大，但C = ±8和±12的相对大小对磁场敏感。应变半金属的间隙层级与有限磁场下的不可压缩性测量结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 垂直磁场下的朗道能级间隙大小层级可作为判别Mott半金属与应变诱导各向异性半金属的尖锐实验探针，应变半金属模型在现有实验数据下更具支持性。

title: Electronic Toroidal Metals: Landau Theory and Magnetoelectric Fingerprints
summary: Toroidal order is a higher-rank multipolar order whose intrinsic realization in itinerant-electron systems remains unexplored. Here, we develop a generic theory of the electronic toroidal metal (ETM), in which toroidal order emerges spontaneously from electronic degrees of freedom near the Fermi surfaces. Because candidate toroidal bilinears can overlap by symmetry with the uniform charge current, we formulate a projected instability criterion that removes the noncondensable current component. Within this current-orthogonal sector, we identify a soft collective mode in the $\mathcal{P}$-odd and $\mathcal{T}$-odd particle-hole channel and demonstrate that ETM arises as a Fermi-liquid instability. We then define the toroidal moment in an itinerant system through the antisymmetric magnetoelectric response tensor. We further establish an intimate connection between this response and the topology of pseudospin texture: the rearrangement of pseudospin vortices changes the winding structure of the Fermi surfaces and markedly enhances the magnetoelectric response. ETM also exhibits characteristic nonlinear charge transport, including a pronounced enhancement of its interband quantum-geometric contribution. Our results establish ETM as a distinct metallic Landau phase and provide a general framework for understanding toroidal order generated by itinerant electrons.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一个关于电子环形金属（ETM）的通用理论，证明了环形序可以在巡游电子系统中自发涌现为费米液体不稳定性，并通过反对称磁电响应张量定义环形矩，揭示了伪自旋涡旋重排对磁电响应的增强以及非线性电荷输运的特征。
AI.motivation: 环形序是一种高阶多极序，但其在巡游电子系统中的内在实现此前未被探索。作者旨在填补这一空白，建立巡游电子系统中环形序自发涌现的理论框架。
AI.method: 作者提出了投影不稳定性判据以去除不可凝聚的电流分量（因为候选环形双线性可能因对称性与均匀电荷电流重叠），在电流正交扇区中识别出P-奇和T-奇的粒子-空穴通道软集体模式，并通过反对称磁电响应张量定义巡游系统中的环形矩，同时研究伪自旋纹理拓扑与磁电响应的联系及非线性输运特性。
AI.result: 证明ETM作为费米液体不稳定性出现；伪自旋涡旋重排改变费米面的缠绕结构并显著增强磁电响应；ETM展现出特征性的非线性电荷输运，包括带间量子几何贡献的显著增强。
AI.conclusion: ETM是一种独特的金属朗道相，该工作为理解巡游电子产生的环形序提供了通用框架。

title: Doping-driven Mott transition from steady-state density functional theory
summary: The doping-driven Mott transition in the Hubbard model is described within the frame- work of steady-state density functional theory, or i-DFT. In order to access the many-body spectral function in i-DFT, an approximation for the exchange-correlation (xc) bias at arbitrary density and current is required. By using Fermi-liquid theory, a connection between the xc bias of i-DFT and the quasiparticle weight of many-body theory is derived and the results are employed to guide the construction of the approximation. Numerical results obtained with this functional demonstrate that the doping-driven Mott transition can indeed be captured with i-DFT.

AI.tldr: 本文在稳态密度泛函理论（i-DFT）框架下描述了掺杂驱动的Hubbard模型Mott转变。通过费米液体理论推导了i-DFT的交换关联偏压与多体理论准粒子权重之间的联系，并以此指导构建近似泛函。数值结果表明该泛函能够捕捉掺杂驱动的Mott转变。
AI.motivation: 在i-DFT框架下研究掺杂驱动的Mott转变，需要访问多体谱函数，而这依赖于任意密度和电流下交换关联（xc）偏压的近似。现有近似缺乏理论基础，需要建立xc偏压与多体理论之间的联系来指导泛函构建。
AI.method: 利用费米液体理论推导i-DFT的xc偏压与多体理论准粒子权重之间的解析关系，以此为依据指导近似泛函的构建，并通过数值计算验证该泛函在Hubbard模型中的表现。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，基于费米液体理论推导的泛函能够成功捕捉掺杂驱动的Mott转变。
AI.conclusion: i-DFT框架通过合理的xc偏压近似能够描述掺杂驱动的Mott转变，为稳态输运中的强关联体系研究提供了新的理论工具。

title: Perspectives on Magnetic/Superconductor Hybrid Systems: Long-range Electromagnetic Phenomena Induced by Proximity Effect and Interfacial Spin-orbit Coupling
comment: Published in Journal of Applied Physics, original version of the paper before copyediting, 21 pages, 16 figures
summary: In this Perspective we review recent achievements in physics and applications of hybrid superconductor-ferromagnet structures. In particular, we focus on the manifestations of the electromagnetic phenomena in these systems originating from the response of the induced superconducting correlations modified by the exchange field and additional effects coming from the interface Rashba-type spin-orbit coupling. The review includes the long-range electromagnetic proximity effect and related modification of magnetic textures, spontaneous currents, properties of vortex matter and its interaction with magnetic ordering, spin-galvanic, photogalvanic and nonreciprocal transport phenomena in exemplary hybrid systems. We also present our views on the future development of this field including both the theoretical challenges and promising opportunities for fundamental experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述性观点文章，回顾了超导体-铁磁体混合结构在物理学和应用方面的最新进展，重点关注由交换场和界面Rashba自旋轨道耦合所引发的电磁现象，包括长程电磁邻近效应、磁纹理修改、自发电流、涡旋物质、自旋-电流效应以及非互易输运现象，并展望了该领域未来的理论挑战和实验机遇。
AI.motivation: 超导体-铁磁体混合结构是凝聚态物理中一个前沿且复杂的领域，其中超导关联与磁性有序的共存和相互作用产生了丰富而独特的电磁现象。该领域近年来取得了大量突破性进展，需要系统性地梳理和整合这些成果，以厘清物理图像并为后续研究指明方向。
AI.method: 作为一篇Perspective综述，本文采用系统性回顾和批判性分析的方法，聚焦于电磁现象：从交换场修饰下的超导关联响应出发，结合界面Rashba自旋轨道耦合效应，分类梳理长程电磁邻近效应、磁纹理重构、自发电流、涡旋物质与磁序相互作用、自旋-电流效应、光电流效应及非互易输运等关键物理现象。
AI.result: 综述总结了超导-铁磁混合结构中一系列关键电磁现象的物理机制和最新实验进展，包括：长程电磁邻近效应及其对磁纹理的调制、体系中的自发电流、涡旋与磁序的相互作用、自旋-电偶（spin-galvanic）效应、光电流效应和非互易输运现象等，并指出了这些现象在典型混合系统中的具体表现。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为该领域未来发展方向应包括：深入解决理论上的未解挑战（如更完整的强关联与自旋轨道耦合统一描述），以及探索基础实验中具有前景的新机会，推动超导-铁磁混合结构在量子器件和拓扑物理等方面的实际应用。

title: Two-dimensional percolation with algebraically decaying interactions II: Critical exponents in the long-range regime
summary: We present a comprehensive Monte Carlo study of two-dimensional bond percolation with algebraically decaying connection probabilities $p(r)\propto 1/r^{2+σ}$, establishing the universality diagram in the long-range (LR) regime for $σ\le2$. Using the event-based ensemble method, we simulate systems with linear sizes up to $L=16384$ and investigate three universality regimes: LR Wilson--Fisher (WF) A ($1<σ\le2$), LR Wilson--Fisher B ($2/3<σ\le1$), and LR mean-field (MF) ($0<σ\le2/3$). In the LR-WF-B regime, the anomalous dimension is consistent with $η=2-σ$, in agreement with mathematical results for $2/3<σ<1$, while the correlation-length exponent $ν(σ)$ exhibits nontrivial, non-Gaussian variation. In the LR-WF-A regime, although $η$ remains close to $2-σ$ for smaller $σ$, statistically resolvable deviations $δη(σ)=η-(2-σ)>0$ start to appear near $σ\simeq3/2$ and grow toward the short-range crossover at $σ=2$. Finally, by complementing the event-based simulations with conventional ensemble simulations, we reveal the coexistence of complete-graph asymptotics and LR Gaussian-fixed-point scaling in the LR-MF regime. These results further clarify the critical properties in long-range percolation and provide crucial benchmarks for long-range statistical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模的蒙特卡洛模拟，系统研究了二维键渗流中代数衰减连接概率的普适性相图，确立了长程区域的三个普适性区间及其临界性质。
AI.motivation: 长程渗流系统的临界性质尚不完全清楚，特别是在不同σ参数区间内的普适性分类及与理论预测的一致性需要更精确的数值验证。
AI.method: 采用基于事件的系综方法，模拟线性尺寸达L=16384的系统，并辅以传统系综模拟进行对比验证，研究三个普适性区间（LR-WF-A、LR-WF-B和LR-MF）的临界行为。
AI.result: 在LR-WF-B区间，反常维数与η=2-σ一致；在LR-WF-A区间，η与2-σ的偏离在σ≃3/2附近开始出现并增长；在LR-MF区间，揭示了完全图渐近行为与长程高斯不动点标度的共存。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果进一步澄清了长程渗流的临界性质，为长程统计系统提供了关键的基准数据，并揭示了不同普适性区间之间交叉行为的细节。

title: Quantum critical behavior in chains of hindered dipolar planar rotors
summary: We study the ground-state properties of linear chains of dipolar planar rotors hindered by a six-fold on-site potential, a model motivated by water molecules confined in the hexagonal cavities of beryl. Using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations, we locate the quantum phase transition between the disordered and ferroelectrically ordered phases using the von Neumann entanglement entropy and the Binder ratio of the polarization. A sweep of the six-fold pinning strength shows that increasing hindrance shifts the critical dipolar coupling gc to smaller values. These results suggest that crystal-field hindrance can promote, rather than suppress, dipolar ordering. This work has implications for ferroelectricity and quantum-device tuning in confined molecular rotors

AI.tldr: 本文利用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法研究受限在六方晶格中的线性偶极平面转子链的基态性质，发现提高六重钉扎强度会将临界偶极耦合gc移向更小值，表明晶体场阻碍可促进而非抑制偶极有序化，这对受限分子转子的铁电性和量子器件调控具有启示意义。
AI.motivation: 该研究源于水分子被限制在绿柱石六方空腔中的物理场景，旨在理解六重on-site势对线性偶极转子链基态性质（无序相与铁电有序相之间量子相变）的影响，并澄清晶体场阻碍对偶极有序化究竟是促进还是抑制的作用。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）数值计算方法，利用von Neumann纠缠熵和极化的Binder比率作为序参量，精确定位无序相与铁电有序相之间的量子相变点，并在不同六重钉扎强度下系统扫描临界偶极耦合gc的变化。
AI.result: 成功定位了量子相变点；系统扫描六重钉扎强度发现，随着阻碍增强，临界偶极耦合gc向更小值移动，表明钉扎势实际上有利于偶极有序的形成。
AI.conclusion: 晶体场阻碍可以促进（而非抑制）偶极有序化，这一发现对受限分子转子体系中的铁电性理解以及量子器件的调控具有重要启示。

title: Real-time ESR tracking for sub-micron 3D magnetic mapping with VB- quantum sensors in hexagonal boron nitride
summary: The discovery of spin-dependent luminescent properties of negatively charged boron-vacancy centers ($V^-_B$) in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) enabled a new platform for quantum sensing with van der Waals materials. Particularly, the possibility of performing optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) for determining the electron spin resonance (ESR) frequencies of hBN color centers became a strong tool for quantum sensing of magnetic fields with submicrometric resolution. However, due to low ODMR contrast, current techniques proposed for mapping DC magnetic fields require hours of integration to obtain a magnetic image of a micron-sized region. In this work, we report the implementation of a frequency-tracking approach for real-time monitoring of ESR frequencies of localized $V^-_B$ centers in hBN. With this technique, magnetic field monitoring was used to map the field pattern generated by a micron-sized conical magnetic tip in only a few minutes. By controlling the magnetic sample's position relative to the quantum sensor, three-dimensional magnetic mapping of the field was achieved with diffraction-limited resolution and shot-noise-limited sensitivity of 54 $μ$T$/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$. Magnetic field gradients of 3.6 $\pm$ 0.2 $μ$T/nm were measured with our system, in which a maximum detected field rate of 6 mT/s was achieved. The results of this study establish spin resonance frequency-tracking as a viable technique and fast method for minute-scale magnetic imaging, reducing acquisition times by at least one order of magnitude if compared to conventional techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种基于频率追踪（frequency-tracking）技术的实时监测方法，用于六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电硼空位中心（V⁻B）的电子自旋共振（ESR）频率，实现了分钟级别的磁成像，将采集时间比传统方法缩短至少一个数量级。
AI.motivation: hBN中的V⁻B色心具有自旋相关的发光特性，可用于ODMR进行量子传感，但传统DC磁场映射技术因ODMR对比度低，需要数小时积分才能获得微米级区域的磁图像，速度太慢。
AI.method: 实现了一种频率追踪方法，实时监测局域V⁻B中心的ESR频率变化，并通过控制磁性样品相对于量子传感器的位置，实现三维磁场映射。
AI.result: 磁场监测在几分钟内完成微米级锥形磁尖的磁场分布映射；实现衍射极限分辨率和散粒噪声极限灵敏度54 μT/√Hz；测得磁场梯度3.6±0.2 μT/nm；最大磁场检测速率6 mT/s；采集时间比传统技术缩短至少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 自旋共振频率追踪被确立为一种可行的快速分钟级磁成像技术，为基于范德华材料的量子传感提供了更高效的方法。

title: An LLM agent for end-to-end computational materials discovery
summary: The coordination of multi-scale tasks is an effective strategy for computational materials discovery, yet the repeated application of diverse algorithms and tools renders it challenging. We report MAESTRO, a large language model (LLM) agent system capable of executing the entire screening pipeline for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). It processes a large body of MOF literature, links relevant publications to their crystal structures, and curates the results into a computation-ready database, which is then screened through a strategy of progressively increasing computational cost. The promising candidates identified for separation under wet flue gas conditions all originate from unrelated studies. By connecting the heterogeneous stages of computational materials discovery, the LLM-based agents of MAESTRO can operate across application domains and uncover high-performance materials that conventional screening approaches would be unlikely to consider.

AI.tldr: MAESTRO是一个基于大语言模型(LLM)的智能体系统，能够自动执行金属有机框架(MOF)材料筛选的完整流程，从文献处理、晶体结构关联、数据库构建到逐级增加计算成本的筛选，最终在潮湿烟道气分离应用中发现了来自不相关研究的高性能候选材料。
AI.motivation: 多尺度任务的协调是计算材料发现的有效策略，但多样算法和工具的重复应用使其变得极具挑战性，需要一种能自动衔接各阶段工作的系统。
AI.method: MAESTRO采用LLM智能体系统，处理大量MOF文献，将相关出版物与其晶体结构关联，构建计算就绪的数据库，并通过逐步增加计算成本的策略进行筛选。
AI.result: 在潮湿烟道气分离条件下识别出的有前景候选材料均源自不相关的研究，表明该系统能发现传统筛选方法不太可能考虑的高性能材料。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体能够连接计算材料发现中的异质阶段，跨应用领域操作，并发现超越传统筛选方法范围的高性能材料。

title: Resolving positive semi-definiteness in physics-informed kernels for scientific machine learning
summary: Many modern machine learning models can be understood as kernel-based function-space models, including Gaussian processes and neural tangent kernels. In scientific machine learning, differential operators are increasingly used to encode physical structure directly into such models. However, it has remained unclear under which conditions these constructions are valid machine learning models, i.e. preserve positive semi-definiteness, and whether observed instabilities arise from ill-posed modeling or numerical effects. Here, we establish a simple and sufficient condition for positive semi-definiteness: for linear differential operators of order m, the base kernel must be m-times continuously differentiable. Crucially, this guarantee holds for operators with non-constant and even discontinuous coefficients. Examples are ubiquitous in physical systems, including diffusion, material elasticity, wave propagation in inhomogeneous media, and quantum systems. We conclude that remaining instabilities are attributable to numerical issues, providing a unifying validity foundation for operator-informed kernel methods.

AI.tldr: 本文为算子化核方法建立了正半定性的充分条件：对于m阶线性微分算子，基核需m次连续可微。该保证适用于非恒定甚至不连续系数的算子，从而将观测到的不稳定性归因于数值问题而非模型不适定性。
AI.motivation: 算子化核方法在科学机器学习中被广泛用于将物理结构编码进核模型，但其作为机器学习模型的有效性（正半定性）条件一直不明确，且观测到的不稳定性根源（模型不适定 vs 数值效应）难以区分。
AI.method: 通过数学分析证明：对于m阶线性微分算子，若基核为m次连续可微，则算子化构造保持正半定性。该证明不依赖于算子的常数性或连续性假设，因此适用于更广泛的物理场景。
AI.result: 建立了简单且充分的PDS条件（基核m次连续可微），并证明该条件对非恒定甚至不连续系数的算子同样成立，涵盖扩散、弹性、非均匀介质波传播和量子系统等物理实例。
AI.conclusion: 剩余的不稳定性应归因于数值问题而非模型构造本身的不适定性，为算子化核方法提供了统一的验证基础。

title: Berry-Curvature Effect in Anomalous Transport
summary: A theory of the Berry-phase effect in anomalous transport in ferromagnets driven by statistical forces such as the gradient of temperature or chemical potential has been developed by Di Xiao et al in Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 026603 (2006) based on a field-dependent density of states generating an additional contribution to the current density. We present an alternative derivation of the Berry- phase effect in anomalous transport in altermagnets and noncentrosymmertric metals based on quasiclassic matrix kinetic equation. Along with anomalous Hall effect an anomalous heat flow and anomalous thermalelectric currents are also derived.

AI.tldr: 本文基于准经典矩阵动力学方程，提供了一种替代方法推导交变磁体和非中心对称金属中异常输运的Berry相位效应，同时导出了异常霍尔效应、异常热流和异常热电电流。
AI.motivation: Di Xiao等人（PRL 2006）基于场依赖态密度方法发展了铁磁体中由统计力（温度梯度或化学势梯度）驱动的异常输运Berry相位效应理论。本文旨在提供一种替代推导方法，适用于交变磁体（altermagnets）和非中心对称金属。
AI.method: 采用准经典矩阵动力学方程（quasiclassic matrix kinetic equation）作为推导框架，替代原先基于场依赖态密度的推导方法，来研究Berry相位效应在异常输运中的作用。
AI.result: 除了推导出异常霍尔效应外，还进一步导出了异常热流和异常热电电流。
AI.conclusion: 准经典矩阵动力学方程为Berry相位效应在异常输运中的研究提供了一种替代且更广泛的推导途径，可推广至交变磁体和非中心对称金属系统。

title: A non-local power-law baseline for transient flux penetration in YBCO films: parameter degeneracy and constitutive limitations
summary: We assess whether a non-local thin-film model with a bounded, constant-exponent power law can reproduce high-speed magneto-optical measurements of transient flux penetration in a $3\times3$~mm$^2$ YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-δ}$ film. The model is solved forward in physical units and used as a controlled constitutive baseline. The critical sheet current is constrained by the final penetration geometry, while the criterion field and creep exponent are constrained by the turnover and relaxation times. The calibration reveals an intrinsic degeneracy: the turnover time depends primarily on the product of the criterion field and saturation parameter, equivalently on the saturated sheet resistivity, so these quantities cannot be identified independently. After parameterizing this degeneracy, the model captures a guarded-current turnover near 22~ms, a relaxation constant of 41.2~ms compared with the measured 37.5 and 43.7~ms, and a late maximum approximately 0.92~mm from the film edge. The amplitude remains discrepant: the calculated transient maximum is $1.90J_{c0}$ and the peak-to-225-ms ratio is 2.13, compared with the reported 1.20. This excess persists under changes in the creep exponent, the degenerate parameter direction, the Kim field dependence, and mesh resolution. Matching the measured ratio through the criterion field would require a value about three orders of magnitude below the conventional scale, while spatial exclusion sufficient to match it would remove the edge peak itself. We also decompose the electric field into irrotational and solenoidal parts and quantify the boundary layer where spectral and finite-difference forms of Faraday's law disagree. The results establish a reproducible non-local power-law baseline and identify limitations of the bounded, constant-exponent constitutive family rather than of non-local thin-film electrodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一个具有有界、恒定指数幂律的非局域薄膜模型能否重现YBCO薄膜中高速磁光测量的瞬态磁通穿透现象。模型校准揭示了内在简并性，捕捉了多个时间尺度，但瞬态幅值存在难以消除的偏差，表明局限在于有界恒定指数的本构族而非非局域薄膜电动力学本身。
AI.motivation: 验证非局域薄膜模型是否能作为可控的基准本构模型来重现高速磁光实验测量的瞬态磁通穿透数据，识别该本构族的局限性。
AI.method: 采用有界、恒定指数幂律的非局域薄膜模型正向求解（物理单位制）。用最终穿透几何约束临界片电流，用转变时间和弛豫时间约束判据场和蠕变指数；将电场分解为无旋场和螺线场部分，量化法拉第定律的谱方法与有限差分形式不一致的边界层。
AI.result: 模型重现了约22ms的守衡电流转变，弛豫常数41.2ms（实验37.5和43.7ms），晚期最大值距边缘约0.92mm。但幅值存在差异：计算瞬态最大值为1.90Jc0，峰-225ms比为2.13，而实验为1.20。该偏差在改变蠕变指数、简并参数方向、Kim场依赖和网格分辨率后依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一个可复现的非局域幂律基线，并指出该有界恒定指数本构族存在固有局限性（幅值偏差约三个数量级才能匹配），但这一局限源于本构族本身而非非局域薄膜电动力学框架。

title: Quantum Wake Dynamics from Distinct Spectroscopic Perturbations
summary: Quantum wake dynamics in quantum magnets have recently been inferred from the dynamical spin structure factor, which probes only a restricted class of local perturbations. Here, we show that resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) selection rules act as an operator filter on fractionalized excitations, producing distinct quantum wakes in the spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ Heisenberg antiferromagnetic chain. Using explicit real-time evolution of single-spin and spin-conserving bond correlators, we find that the conventional spin response propagates up to the maximum spinon velocity, $v_s=\fracπ{2} J$, whereas the bond channels concentrate their spectral weight into a slower dominant wake with $v\simeq 0.92 J$, while weaker components remain bounded by the full spinon light cone. The corresponding momentum- and frequency-resolved responses map onto experimentally accessible RIXS channels, demonstrating that different spectroscopic perturbations resolve complementary pathways of many-body propagation beyond the neutron-scattering spin structure factor. Their inelastic spectral weights further provide access to quantum Fisher information, while equal-time bond sum rules connect the same spectroscopic channels to the ground-state energy. Because the same correlators can be prepared and measured on quantum hardware, they also define direct, experimentally anchored benchmarks for quantum simulations, particularly in frustrated and higher-dimensional magnets where controlled classical real-time calculations become challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究自旋-1/2海森堡反铁磁链中的量子尾流动力学，发现RIXS选择规则可作为分数化激发的算子滤波器，产生与常规自旋响应不同的量子尾流特征。键关联通道将谱权重集中到较慢的主导尾流（v≈0.92J），而自旋通道传播到最大旋子速度（vs=πJ/2），且这些通道可通过RIXS实验测量，并与量子费舍尔信息及基态能量相关联。
AI.motivation: 量子磁体中的量子尾流动力学此前主要通过动力学自旋结构因子推断，但该探针仅能检测有限类别的局域扰动。需要探索其他光谱探针以揭示更丰富的多体传播途径。
AI.method: 利用显式实时演化计算单自旋和自旋守恒键关联函数，研究一维自旋-1/2海森堡反铁磁链中的量子尾流。通过RIXS选择规则将不同算符投影到不同的光谱通道，分析其动量分辨和频率分辨响应，并建立与量子费舍尔信息和基态能量的联系。
AI.result: 传统自旋响应传播到最大旋子速度vs=πJ/2，而键通道将谱权重集中于较慢的主导尾流（v≈0.92J），较弱分量仍受完整旋子光锥约束。这些响应可映射到实验可及的RIXS通道，提供超越中子散射自旋结构因子的互补多体传播信息。
AI.conclusion: 不同光谱扰动可解析多体传播的互补途径，RIXS能提供更丰富的信息维度。相关关联函数可在量子硬件上制备和测量，为量子模拟（尤其在阻挫和高维磁体中）提供直接且实验锚定的基准。

title: $\mathcal{PT}$ and anti-$\mathcal{PT}$ phase transitions in a trimerized Su--Schrieffer--Heeger chain with nonreciprocal Rashba spin-orbit coupling
summary: We theoretically investigate a one-dimensional trimerized Su--Schrieffer--Heeger chain with three sublattices per unit cell subjected to a nonreciprocal Rashba spin-orbit coupling. Invoking a spin-flip symmetry, the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian decomposes into two independent spin sectors, enabling a spin-resolved analysis of non-Hermitian skin effects and system symmetries. We identify a rich phase diagram consisting of four bulk phases and two edge-state phases. The bulk phases include fully $\mathcal{PT}$-unbroken (real-spectrum) and fully anti-$\mathcal{PT}$-unbroken (imaginary-spectrum) regimes, as well as two mixed phases where one band remains on the real or imaginary axis while the other two form complex-conjugate pairs. The two edge-state phases correspond to topological edge modes with either $\mathcal{PT}$-unbroken (real) or anti-$\mathcal{PT}$-unbroken (imaginary) energies. Using non-Bloch band theory and Cardano's method, we derive closed-form expressions for phase boundaries and establish the bulk-edge correspondence for each spin sector. Calculations of Berry phase and directional inverse participation ratios confirm our analytical predictions. Our results provide a minimal platform for realizing spin-resolved non-Hermitian topology and edge-selective symmetry preservation, in which the bulk and edge states belong to distinct symmetry classes.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了一维三聚化Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链，该链在非互易Rashba自旋轨道耦合下展现出丰富的非厄米拓扑现象。通过自旋翻转对称性将非厄米哈密顿量分解为两个独立的自旋扇区，发现了包含四种体态相和两种边缘态相的相图，并利用非Bloch能带理论和Cardano方法推导了相边界的闭式表达式，建立了每个自旋扇区的体边对应关系。
AI.motivation: 探索非厄米系统中自旋分辨的非厄米皮肤效应和拓扑性质，特别是体态与边缘态属于不同对称性类别的体系，为自旋分辨非厄米拓扑提供最小化实现平台。
AI.method: 利用自旋翻转对称性分解非厄米哈密顿量为两个独立自旋扇区；采用非Bloch能带理论和Cardano方法推导相边界闭式表达式；通过Berry相位和方向性逆参与比（directional IPR）进行数值验证。
AI.result: 识别出四种体态相（完全PT未破缺、完全反PT未破缺以及两种混合相）和两种边缘态相（PT未破缺或反PT未破缺的拓扑边缘模）；推导出相边界的解析表达式；建立了自旋分辨的体边对应关系并确认了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个最小化平台，用于实现自旋分辨的非厄米拓扑和边缘选择性对称保持，其中体态和边缘态属于不同的对称性类别，深化了对非厄米拓扑相的理解。

title: Symmetry Adapted Hierarchical Equations of Motion for Exact Simulations of Large Polariton Systems
summary: Hierarchical equations of motion(HEOM) provide exact dynamics of open quantum systems coupled to harmonic baths, but their computational cost becomes prohibitive for systems with many independent local environments. In this work, we develop a symmetry-adapted HEOM formalism to significantly reduce the computational cost for the permutationally invariant Holstein-Tavis-Cummings (HTC) model. The method removes redundant information in two stages. First, all auxiliary density operators (ADOs) related only by relabeling identical molecules and their bath channels are replaced by a single canonical occupation-pattern representative. Second, molecules with the same local hierarchy occupation produce repeated matrix elements within each representative, allowing only the distinct complex variables to be propagated instead of the full (N + 1) $\times$ (N + 1) ADO matrices. The resulting matrix-free equations are evaluated using precomputed connections and molecular multiplicities. At fixed hierarchy depth L and number of bath correlation exponentials m, the number of canonical representatives becomes independent of the ensemble size for N $\geq$ L and the number of unique variables saturates for N $\geq$ L + 2. The formulation easily extends to multiple-exponential bath decompositions, arbitrary initial density operators, static disorders, and cavity loss. Our benchmarks reproduce conventional HEOM dynamics while requiring far fewer propagated variables and substantially less memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种对称性自适应的HEOM（层次运动方程）形式，用于显著降低置换不变的Holstein-Tavis-Cummings (HTC)模型的量子动力学计算成本。该方法通过两阶段消除冗余：首先用单个规范占据模式代表替换仅通过相同分子重标号相关的辅助密度算子（ADOs），其次利用分子重复性仅传播不同的复变量而非完整的(N+1)×(N+1)矩阵。在固定分层深度L和浴关联指数m时，规范代表数对N≥L独立于体系大小，唯一变量数在N≥L+2时达到饱和。该方法可扩展到多指数浴分解、任意初始密度算子、静态无序和腔损耗，在复现传统HEOM动力学结果的同时大幅减少传播变量数和内存占用。
AI.motivation: HEOM方法能精确描述开放量子系统与谐波浴的动力学，但当系统包含大量独立局域环境时，其计算成本急剧增长，变得不可行。特别是对具有置换对称性的HTC模型，传统HEOM中存在大量冗余信息，亟需一种利用对称性来降低计算复杂度的方法。
AI.method: 开发对称性自适应的HEOM形式，分两阶段消除冗余：第一阶段将仅通过相同分子重标号相关的ADOs合并为单一规范占据模式代表；第二阶段利用相同局域分层占据的分子产生重复矩阵元素，仅传播不同复变量。采用预计算连接和分子多重性来评估无矩阵方程，并支持多指数浴分解、任意初始态、静态无序和腔损耗。
AI.result: 在固定分层深度L和浴关联指数m下，规范代表数在N≥L时独立于体系大小，唯一变量数在N≥L+2时饱和。基准测试表明该方法能复现传统HEOM动力学，同时需要的传播变量更少，内存占用大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 该对称性自适应的HEOM形式为置换不变的HTC模型提供了一种高效的精确动力学模拟方案，显著减轻了计算负担，且具有良好的可扩展性和通用性，适用于更广泛的物理场景。

title: Carrier Capture at Defects from Finite-Temperature Lattice Dynamics
summary: Defect-assisted carrier capture is commonly described within nonradiative multiphonon (NMP) theory using normal modes of the equilibrium defect structure. This description becomes inadequate when finite-temperature lattice fluctuations explore configurations that cannot be represented by a fixed normal-mode basis. Here, we present a trajectory-based method for calculating carrier capture rate from first principles, which allows lattice relaxation and electron--lattice coupling matrix element to be reconstructed directly from correlation functions of finite-temperature lattice dynamics. For hole capture at C$_\mathrm{N}$ in GaN within harmonic regime, the method reproduces static NMP results including mode mixing and agrees with experiment. For oxygen vacancy in SiO$_2$, by contrast, the thermally sampled potential energy surface is substantially softer than the zero-temperature normal-mode harmonic expansion, strongly modifying the lattice relaxation and electron--lattice coupling, and producing pronounced changes in both the capture coefficient and its temperature dependence. These results establish the finite-temperature configurational ensemble, rather than phonon occupations alone, as an essential ingredient of defect-assisted carrier capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于轨迹的第一性原理方法，通过有限温度晶格动力学的关联函数直接重建晶格弛豫和电子-晶格耦合矩阵元，用于计算载流子俘获速率。该方法在GaN中C_N的谐波区内复现了静态NMP结果并与实验吻合；但对SiO₂中的氧空位，热采样势能面比零温正常模式明显更软，显著改变了俘获系数及其温度依赖。结果表明有限温度构型系综（而非仅声子占据数）是缺陷辅助载流子俘获的关键要素。
AI.motivation: 传统的非辐射多声子（NMP）理论基于平衡缺陷结构的简正模式来描述缺陷辅助载流子俘获，但在有限温度下晶格涨落会探索无法由固定简正模态基底表示的构型，因此需要一种能考虑有限温度构型系综的第一性原理方法来计算俘获速率。
AI.method: 提出基于分子动力学轨迹的方法：从有限温度晶格动力学的关联函数中直接重建晶格弛豫量和电子-晶格耦合矩阵元，从而计算载流子俘获速率，无需依赖零温简正模态基底。
AI.result: 在GaN中C_N的谐波区内，该方法复现了含模式混合的静态NMP结果并与实验一致；在SiO₂氧空位中，热采样势能面显著软于零温简正模态谐波展开，大幅改变了晶格弛豫和电子-晶格耦合，导致俘获系数及其温度依赖发生显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 有限温度构型系综（而非仅声子占据数）是缺陷辅助载流子俘获的不可或缺的要素，传统NMP理论在显著非谐或强温度效应的体系中可能不充分。

title: Emergent Vibronic Spectral Hierarchy in a Kagome Flat-Band Insulator
summary: Electron-phonon coupling is usually understood in terms of electronic quasiparticles interacting with dispersive lattice vibrations. Much less is known about the complementary limit in which the relevant phonon mode is itself localized or weakly dispersive. Here we investigate this regime in the kagome compound Rb$_{2}$Ni$_{3}$S$_{4}$, which undergoes an unconventional insulating transition near $T^{*} \approx$ 260-280~K. Combining polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy with temperature-dependent x-ray diffraction, scanning tunneling microscopy, and electrical, thermal, and magnetic measurements, we show that the transition involves electronic localization without a conventional structural or magnetic order parameter. Raman spectra reveal a giant Franck-Condon progression associated with a nearly dispersionless 333.7~cm$^{-1}$ phonon, decorated by an equally spaced comb-like fine structure with a characteristic spacing of 40.6~cm$^{-1}$. The comb spacing is insensitive to magnetic field, whereas its spectral weight is strongly field tunable. Rather than treating either hierarchy alone as pure phonon effect, we interpret their nested coexistence as evidence for a strongly coupled electron-vibrational manifold involving a localized lattice coordinate. These results identify dispersionless phonons as an active route to vibronic correlations in solids and suggest that such electron-vibrational self-trapping is closely associated with the insulating phase of Rb$_{2}$Ni$_{3}$S$_{4}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了kagome化合物Rb₂Ni₃S₄中无展宽（近无色散）声子模式与电子-振动耦合的机制。通过多种实验手段，发现其在T*≈260-280K发生非常规绝缘转变，涉及电子局域化但无传统结构或磁序参数。拉曼光谱揭示了一个近无色散声子的大Franck-Condon级数，并伴有等间距梳状精细结构（间距40.6 cm⁻¹）。梳间距对磁场不敏感但谱权重可被磁场调控。作者将此嵌套共存解释为强耦合的电子-振动流形，表明无色散声子可作为固体中振动耦合关联的有效途径，与绝缘相密切相关。
AI.motivation: 传统上电子-声子耦合被理解为电子准粒子与色散的晶格振动相互作用，但对声子模式本身局域化或弱色散这一互补极限的认知较少。作者旨在探索这一被忽视的领域，研究局域化声子在固体电子关联中的作用。
AI.method: 采用多种实验手段联合分析：偏振分辨拉曼光谱、温度依赖X射线衍射、扫描隧道显微镜，以及电学、热学和磁学测量。重点分析拉曼光谱中的Franck-Condon级数及其梳状精细结构，并结合磁场调控实验来验证电子-振动耦合的本质。
AI.result: 发现Rb₂Ni₃S₄在T*≈260-280K发生非常规绝缘转变，表现为电子局域化但无传统结构或磁有序参数。拉曼光谱显示近无色散333.7 cm⁻¹声子的大Franck-Condon级数，叠加等间距40.6 cm⁻¹的梳状精细结构。梳间距对磁场不敏感，但谱权重强烈受磁场调控。
AI.conclusion: 该嵌套的Franck-Condon级数和梳状结构不能用单一纯声子效应解释，而是强耦合电子-振动流形的证据，涉及局域化晶格坐标。该研究揭示无色散声子是固体中振动相关性的有效途径，此类电子-振动自陷机制与Rb₂Ni₃S₄的绝缘相密切相关。

title: Time-Resolved Thermal Susceptibility Mapping via Low-Temperature Scanning Laser Microscopy
summary: We present a multiharmonic lock-in detection approach that utilizes the inverse Fast Fourier Transform to reconstruct the time evolution of thermal susceptibility with high spatial resolution. The method is implemented on a custom-built, modular scanning laser microscope designed for operation in low working-distance optical cryostats and thoroughly calibrated for spatial accuracy. A demonstrative case study using a superconducting resonator highlights the capability of this technique to generate thermal images on time scales significantly shorter than the intrinsic scanning speed, thus enabling dynamic thermal characterization with high spatial fidelity. The proposed technique of low-temperature time-resolved scanning laser microscopy offers unique opportunities to explore superconducting devices, 2D materials, hybrid planar structures, and other low-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多谐波锁相检测方法，利用逆快速傅里叶变换（IFFT）在高空间分辨率下重建热敏性的时间演化。该方法在定制模块化扫描激光显微镜上实现，适用于低工作距离光学低温恒温器，并通过超导谐振器的案例研究展示了其在远短于固有扫描时间尺度上生成热图像的能力，实现了高空间保真度的动态热表征。
AI.motivation: 现有的低温扫描激光显微镜技术在动态热表征方面存在时间分辨率不足的问题，难以在短时间内获得高空间分辨率的动态热图像。作者希望通过多谐波锁相检测结合IFFT重建来解决这一问题，从而实现对超导器件、二维材料等低维系统的动态热学特性研究。
AI.method: 该方法采用多谐波锁相检测技术，利用逆快速傅里叶变换（IFFT）从多个谐波分量中重建热敏性的时间演化信号。仪器方面使用定制模块化扫描激光显微镜，设计用于低工作距离光学低温恒温器环境，并经过空间精度校准。
AI.result: 通过超导谐振器的演示案例研究，该技术成功在远短于固有扫描速度的时间尺度上生成热图像，实现了高空间保真度的动态热表征，验证了方法的有效性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该低温时间分辨扫描激光显微技术为探索超导器件、二维材料、混合平面结构及其他低维系统提供了独特的动态热学表征机会，有望在这些领域的研究中发挥重要作用。

title: Meandering stripes in the frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ Ising model on the honeycomb lattice
summary: We study the frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ Ising model on the honeycomb lattice with ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor couplings fixed at $J_1=1$ and strong antiferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbor interactions, i.e., $J_2 \leq -1/4$. Little is known for this range of $J_2$, whereas for less negative values of $J_2$ the system orders ferromagnetically at low temperatures and appears to remain in the Ising universality class. In previous work it was shown that the model has a largely degenerate ground state, and it was conjectured that there is some kind of phase transition. We introduce a complex-valued nematic order parameter, which can differentiate between the high-temperature paramagnetic phase and the observed partially-disordered stripe phase at lower temperatures. Configurations in this phase consist of stripes of spins parallel with respect to one lattice direction, which collectively meander along the remaining two, producing partially disordered ground states. The sharp peaks in the specific heat observed in earlier work only appear when using periodic boundary conditions and are absent for free boundaries. Additionally, we reveal a striking dependence of the behavior on the aspect ratio of the considered samples. Ultimately, even a careful finite-size scaling analysis for $J_2 = -0.5$ and $J_2 = -1$ is unable to clearly discern between a crossover without any singularities and some form of continuous transition, including the possibility of an infinite-order transition of the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) type. For $J_2=-1/4$ we find that the system remains disordered at all temperatures and that it exhibits a finite ground-state entropy per site, for which our simulations provide the accurate asymptotic estimate $S(T=0)/N = 0.230\,960\,93(14)$ in the thermodynamic limit $N\rightarrow\infty$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了蜂窝格子上具有铁磁最近邻（J1=1）和强反铁磁次近邻（J2≤-1/4）相互作用的受阻J1-J2 Ising模型。作者引入复值向列序参量来区分高温顺磁相和低温部分无序条纹相，发现比热峰仅出现在周期性边界条件下。有限尺寸分析无法明确区分交叉行为与连续相变（包括BKT型无限阶相变）。对于J2=-1/4，系统在所有温度下保持无序，并具有有限的基态熵密度，热力学极限下估算为S(T=0)/N=0.23096093(14)。
AI.motivation: 对于J2≤-1/4这一参数范围的蜂窝格子J1-J2 Ising模型知之甚少，而此前已知该模型具有高度简并的基态并存在相变猜想，需要深入理解其低温行为与相变性质。
AI.method: 引入复值向列序参量以区分顺磁相和部分无序条纹相；通过蒙特卡洛模拟结合不同边界条件（周期/自由）及不同样本长宽比进行系统研究，并实施细致的有限尺寸标度分析。
AI.result: 发现比热峰仅出现于周期边界条件下而自由边界下消失；系统行为对样本长宽比敏感；对于J2=-0.5和J2=-1，无法清晰区分交叉行为与连续相变（包括BKT型）；对于J2=-1/4，系统在所有温度下保持无序，基态熵密度估算为0.23096093(14)。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在强反铁磁次近邻耦合下展现出丰富的物理行为（部分无序条纹相、有限基态熵、可能的BKT型相变），但相变性质仍不明确，需要进一步研究以确定是否存在真正的奇异相变或仅是无奇异性的交叉。

title: Interband plasmons due to Mexican hat dispersion in two-dimensional materials with inverted bands
summary: Two-dimensional topological materials with Mexican-hat dispersion exhibit numerous nontrivial features, such as double-valued isoenergetic contours in k-space, strong mixing of electron and hole states, a van Hove singularity in the density of states, and specific quantum geometric properties. We find that, due to these features, Mexican-hat dispersion significantly strengthens interband plasmons, reduces their damping, and gives rise to an additional branch of the plasmon spectrum when electron-hole symmetry is broken. The plasmon spectra are limited to a finite range of the wave vector, the boundaries of which depend on the strength of the electron-electron interaction. We also reveal a relationship between the features of the plasmon spectrum and singularities of the joint density of states with a finite plasmon wave vector q, as well as features of the interband quantum metric, which also depend on q.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有墨西哥帽色散的二维拓扑材料中的等离激元（plasmon）特性，发现这种色散能显著增强带间等离激元、降低其阻尼，并在电子-空穴对称性破缺时产生新的等离激元分支。等离激元谱被限制在有限波矢范围内，且与联合态密度和带间量子度量的奇异性存在关联。
AI.motivation: 墨西哥帽色散是二维拓扑材料中一种独特的能带结构，具有等能轮廓双值、电子-空穴态强混合、范霍夫奇点和特殊量子几何性质等非平凡特征。理解这些特征对等离激元（集体激发）的影响，对探索此类材料的光电与量子物性具有重要意义。
AI.method: 本研究从理论上分析了墨西哥帽色散对带间等离激元的影响，考察了电子-空穴对称性破缺情形下的等离激元谱分支结构，并通过联合态密度（joint density of states）和带间量子度量（interband quantum metric）与等离激元谱特征建立关联分析。
AI.result: 研究发现：墨西哥帽色散能显著增强带间等离激元并降低其阻尼；在电子-空穴对称性破缺时会出现额外的等离激元谱分支；等离激元谱仅存在于有限的波矢范围内，其边界依赖于电子-电子相互作用强度；同时揭示了等离激元谱特征与有限波矢q的联合态密度奇异性及带间量子度量特征之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 墨西哥帽色散为二维拓扑材料中的等离激元提供了独特的调控机制，其等离激元谱特征与能带几何和态密度奇异性紧密相关，为理解和操控此类材料中的集体激发奠定了基础。

title: Accurate and Transferable Intermolecular Potential Based on Machine-Learned Molecular Electron Density
summary: Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) contain many learnable parameters and therefore require large training datasets. This poses a challenge for developing highly accurate, general-purpose MLFFs because generating high-quality ab initio reference data is computationally expensive. Classical empirical potentials offer a potentially inexpensive source of synthetic training data, but existing models often lack the accuracy needed to provide useful reference energies. Here, we introduce the density-based intermolecular potential (DensIP), a physics-based model of intermolecular interactions that uses machine-learned electron densities and only four universal parameters. We train and test DensIP on CCSD(T)/CBS interaction energies from DES15K, a dataset of dimers of small organic molecules. DensIP achieves sub-kcal/mol errors for dimers containing molecules absent from the training set, including molecules in non-equilibrium conformations, demonstrating strong transferability. We further show that DensIP can be applied to molecules as large as drug ligands. Notably, DensIP outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose MLFFs for long-range interactions, making it a promising approach for generating accurate synthetic training data at scale.

AI.tldr: DensIP是一种基于物理的分子间相互作用模型，利用机器学习得到的电子密度和仅四个通用参数，能以亚kcal/mol精度预测相互作用能，适用于训练集中未出现的大分子（如药物配体），并优于通用MLFF的长程相互作用表现，为大规模生成准确的合成训练数据提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: MLFF包含大量可学习参数，需要大规模高质量训练数据，而生成高质量从头算参考数据计算成本高昂。经典经验势可作为廉价合成数据源，但现有模型精度不足。因此需要一种既能提供高精度参考能量又计算成本低的物理模型。
AI.method: 提出DensIP（基于密度的分子间势能）模型，使用机器学习得到的电子密度和仅四个通用参数来建模分子间相互作用。在DES15K数据集上进行训练和测试，该数据集包含基于CCSD(T)/CBS级别的小有机分子二聚体相互作用能。
AI.result: DensIP对训练集中未出现的分子（包括非平衡构象的分子）实现了亚kcal/mol的误差，展现出强迁移能力。可应用于药物配体级别的大分子，在长程相互作用方面优于最先进的通用MLFF。
AI.conclusion: DensIP是一种高精度、强迁移性的物理基础模型，有潜力作为生成大规模准确合成训练数据的高效工具，可帮助解决MLFF对高质量训练数据的需求瓶颈。

title: Revealing the Role of Confined Molecular H$_2$ in the Passivation of Defective Silicon Using First-Principles Simulations
summary: The passivation of silicon dangling bonds by hydrogen is a crucial requirement for silicon-based optoelectronic technology, especially for solar cells. Recent experiments on intense light soaking of silicon heterojunction solar cells unveiled interesting dynamical aspects of hydrogen passivation that are linked to Si-H bond breaking and repassivation. These processes take place predominantly in porous regions near the amorphous/crystalline interface, where hydrogen can exist in molecular form. This work addresses the question of whether molecular H$_2$ directly participates in Si-H depassivation and repassivation. Using density functional theory, we calculate and compare formation energies of point defects, multivacancy cavities and the Si(100) surface to identify relevant passivated and depassivated states. Furthermore, we employ nudged elastic band calculations to determine the activation barriers of the corresponding pathways. We find that sufficient local free volume enables a direct double-H pathway for depassivation through the formation of confined molecular H$_2$. Despite involving the breaking of two Si-H bonds, the double-H process can be energetically and kinetically competitive with the single-H process and can exhibit a reverse repassivation barrier as low as $0.15\,$eV under p-type conditions. These findings provide a plausible atomistic explanation for passivation recovery during light soaking and illuminated annealing in porous regions near amorphous/crystalline silicon interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文利用密度泛函理论(DFT)和爬坡弹性带方法(NEB)，研究了硅/非晶硅界面附近多孔区域中，分子H₂是否直接参与Si-H键的去钝化和再钝化过程。研究发现，在足够的局部自由体积条件下，存在一条通过形成受限分子H₂的双氢去钝化路径，该路径在能量和动力学上与单氢过程具有竞争力，且p型条件下再钝化势垒可低至0.15 eV。
AI.motivation: 硅悬键的氢钝化对硅基光电子技术（尤其是太阳能电池）至关重要。近期实验发现强光浸泡硅异质结太阳能电池时，氢钝化呈现有趣的动力学行为，涉及Si-H键断裂和再钝化，这些过程主要发生在a-Si/c-Si界面附近的多孔区域（此处氢可以分子形式存在）。作者希望探究分子H₂是否直接参与Si-H去钝化和再钝化过程。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论(DFT)计算点缺陷、多空位腔和Si(100)表面的形成能，以识别相关的钝化和去钝化态；并使用爬坡弹性带(NEB)方法确定相应反应路径的激活势垒。
AI.result: 发现足够的局部自由体积能够实现通过形成受限分子H₂的直接双氢去钝化路径。尽管涉及断裂两个Si-H键，双氢过程在能量和动力学上可与单氢过程相竞争，且在p型条件下反向再钝化势垒可低至0.15 eV。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为强光浸泡和光照退火过程中，a-Si/c-Si界面附近多孔区域内的钝化恢复现象提供了合理的原子级解释。

title: Scalable photoexcitation-induced molecular dynamics with machine-learned Hamiltonians
summary: Ultrafast photoexcitation offers a controllable route to steer structural dynamics in solids, yet predicting how nonequilibrium electronic excitation drives lattice motion across extended spatial and temporal scales remains a major computational challenge. Here we introduce time-dependent ab-initio propagation with electronic machine learning (TDAP-eML), a framework that explicitly incorporates electronic evolution into scalable simulations of photoexcitation-induced lattice dynamics. By integrating machine-learned electronic structure with atomistic propagation, TDAP-eML describes how photoexcitation reshapes the evolving energy landscapes and forces governing structural motion. Across representative examples including silicon and FeSe, the framework reproduces key photoexcited lattice responses obtained from first-principles time-dependent density functional theory calculations and captures coherent phonon dynamics together with their dependence on excitation conditions. Its computational advantage increases with system size, reaching nearly three orders of magnitude reduction in computational cost for the large systems examined. TDAP-eML thus establishes a scalable framework for coupled electronic and lattice evolution, linking nonequilibrium excitation to photoinduced forces, predictive structural dynamics, and experimentally accessible observables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TDAP-eML的框架，将机器学习的电子结构与原子传播相结合，用于模拟光激发诱导的晶格动力学。该方法在硅和FeSe等代表性体系中复现了第一性原理TDDFT计算的激发态晶格响应，并实现了近三个数量级的计算加速。
AI.motivation: 超快光激发为调控固体结构动力学提供了可控途径，但预测非平衡电子激发如何驱动跨越广阔时空尺度的晶格运动仍是一个重大计算挑战，现有方法难以兼顾精度和可扩展性。
AI.method: TDAP-eML框架将机器学习的电子结构与原子传播显式整合，通过机器学习电子结构描述光激发如何重塑演化中的能量景观和力，从而实现光激发诱导晶格动力学的可扩展模拟。
AI.result: 在硅和FeSe等代表性体系中，框架成功复现了第一性原理含时密度泛函理论计算的关键光激发晶格响应，捕捉了相干声子动力学及其对激发条件的依赖。计算优势随体系尺寸增大而增强，在大体系中实现了近三个数量级的计算成本降低。
AI.conclusion: TDAP-eML建立了一个可扩展的电子-晶格耦合演化框架，将非平衡激发与光致力、预测性结构动力学以及实验可观测的物理量联系起来。

title: Two distinct gap structures in the mid-infrared optical conductivity of the Hubbard model
summary: Mid-infrared (MIR) optical conductivities in cuprate superconductors show universal features. In this study, we demonstrate that these originate from two distinct gaps: the pseudogap mediated by antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations and the Mott-Hubbard gap. The MIR spectra from these two gaps show a characteristic and distinct shape and doping dependence, and can thus be distinguished. Specifically, the Mott-Hubbard correlations, while rendering a peak in the visible spectrum for small dopings, yield a broad optical response starting in the MIR when a ``waterfall'' develops in the one-particle spectrum at larger dopings. The numerically and analytically determined doping-dependence of both gaps consistently reproduce experiments, and provide a unified microscopic understanding of the cuprate MIR optical conductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值和解析方法证明，铜氧化物超导体中红外光学电导率的普适特征起源于两个不同的能隙：由反铁磁自旋涨落介导的赝能隙和Mott-Hubbard能隙，两者具有不同的谱形状和掺杂依赖，可被区分并为实验结果提供统一的微观理解。
AI.motivation: 铜氧化物超导体中红外光学电导率表现出普适特征，但其微观起源尚不清楚，需要解释这些特征背后的物理机制。
AI.method: 通过数值计算与解析分析相结合的方法，分别考察赝能隙（由反铁磁自旋涨落介导）和Mott-Hubbard能隙对中红外光学响应的贡献，并分析其掺杂依赖关系。
AI.result: 两个能隙在中红外谱中呈现特征性且可区分的形状与掺杂依赖：Mott-Hubbard关联在小掺杂时给出可见光区峰，在较大掺杂时单粒子谱出现"瀑布"结构从而产生起始于中红外区的宽光学响应；两个能隙的掺杂依赖均与实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为铜氧化物中红外光学电导率提供了统一的微观理解，揭示了赝能隙与Mott-Hubbard能隙各自独立且可区分的贡献。

title: Superconducting ground state study of Cr-based equiatomic high-entropy alloy through $μ\text{SR}$
summary: High-entropy alloy superconductors, characterized by extreme chemical disorder and complex electronic environments, have attracted significant attention as model systems for exploring superconductivity in disordered materials. Here, we investigate a Cr-based equiatomic HEA, Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta, which contains a magnetic 3d element, providing an opportunity to examine the influence of magnetic elements on superconductivity in highly disordered systems. Despite expected magnetic pair-breaking, this alloy exhibits bulk type-II superconductivity with a transition temperature of $T_c = 2.33(3)$ K and a high upper critical field. Transverse-field $μ$SR measurements reveal an s-wave superconducting gap close to the BCS value, while zero-field $μ$SR suggests preserved time-reversal symmetry. These results establish Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta as a promising platform for exploring the interplay between disorder, magnetism and superconductivity in high entropy alloys.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统研究了含磁性3d元素Cr的等原子高熵合金超导体Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta。尽管磁性元素预期会导致磁对破缺，该合金仍表现出块体II型超导性，超导转变温度Tc=2.33(3)K，且具有较高的上临界场。通过μSR测量揭示其为接近BCS值的s波超导能隙，零场μSR表明时间反演对称性得以保持。
AI.motivation: 高熵合金超导体因其极端化学无序和复杂电子环境，为探索无序材料中的超导性提供了理想模型系统。本研究旨在考察含有磁性3d元素（Cr）的HEA中，磁性元素如何影响高度无序系统中的超导行为，以理解磁性与超导性在无序环境中的相互作用。
AI.method: 选取Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta等原子高熵合金作为研究对象，通过电输运测量确定超导转变温度和上临界场；利用横向场μSR测量探测超导能隙结构；利用零场μSR测量检验时间反演对称性是否破缺。
AI.result: 合金表现出块体II型超导性，Tc=2.33(3)K且具有高上临界场；横向场μSR揭示s波超导能隙接近BCS值；零场μSR显示时间反演对称性保持，未观察到自旋破缺迹象；磁性元素Cr的存在并未破坏超导性。
AI.conclusion: Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta被确立为研究高熵合金中无序、磁性及超导性相互作用的理想平台，表明在极端化学无序环境中磁性元素与超导性可以共存。

title: Planar Nanofluidic Memristors Enabled by Surface Charge Gradient
comment: Main text: 7 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary material: 17 pages, 13 figures
summary: Nanofluidic memristors, exploiting ion transport in nanochannels, hold promise for neuromorphic applications. A planar architecture is particularly desired for scalable integration with established micro- and nanofabrication technologies. Here, using the Poisson-Nernst-Planck framework, we theoretically propose planar nanofluidic memristors enabled by surface charge gradient, providing an alternative to the commonly used geometrically asymmetric architectures. The resulting memristive behavior is governed by a diffusion-mediated secondary enrichment effect. By systematically solving the PNP equations, we obtain the scaling of the characteristic memory time across the parameter space. We also reveal that the memory effect is related to the first-order moment of surface charge, for arbitrary charge profiles. These results provide a theoretical basis for rationally designing and optimizing planar nanofluidic memristors through spatially patterned surface charge.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过泊松-能斯特-普朗克（PNP）框架，从理论上提出了由表面电荷梯度驱动的平面纳米流体忆阻器，作为一种替代几何非对称结构的方案，并揭示了扩散介导的次级富集效应是忆阻行为的核心机制。
AI.motivation: 纳米流体忆阻器在神经形态应用中具有潜力，但现有方案多依赖几何非对称结构，不利于与成熟微纳加工技术进行规模化集成。因此需要探索平面构型下的忆阻实现途径，以实现可扩展集成。
AI.method: 采用泊松-能斯特-普朗克（PNP）方程框架，通过系统求解PNP方程组，在参数空间中获取特征记忆时间的标度关系，并针对任意电荷分布分析了记忆效应与表面电荷一阶矩之间的关联。
AI.result: 提出了平面纳米流体忆阻器的理论方案，揭示了扩散介导的次级富集效应作为忆阻行为的主导机制，获得了特征记忆时间的标度规律，并证明了记忆效应与表面电荷一阶矩之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为通过空间图案化表面电荷理性设计和优化平面纳米流体忆阻器提供了理论基础，有望推动纳米流体忆阻器在可扩展神经形态器件中的实际应用。

title: Orbital-Optimized Quasi-Variational Distinguishable Cluster Doubles Method
summary: We present the orbital-optimized quasi-variational distinguishable cluster doubles (OQVDCD) method, obtained by applying the distinguishable cluster (DC) approximation to orbital-optimized quasi-variational coupled cluster doubles (OQVCCD). The resulting method retains a Hermitian-like energy functional, is size-extensive, obeys the generalized Hellmann-Feynman theorem at a stationary point, is exact in the isolated two-electron and two-hole limits, and scales as O(o2v4), like coupled cluster singles and doubles (CCSD). For the tested closed-shell reaction energies, it is shown that OQVDCD reduces the mean absolute deviation relative to OQVCCD from 1.20 to 0.81 kcal/mol, bringing the errors close to distinguishable cluster singles and doubles (DCSD). In the strongly correlated examples considered here, OQVDCD shifts the OQVCCD energies toward the benchmark, although the convergence remains somewhat less robust than for DCSD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨道优化准变分可区分团簇双激发方法（OQVDCD），通过对轨道优化准变分耦合团簇双激发（OQVCCD）施加可区分团簇（DC）近似获得。该方法保留类厄米能量泛函、具有大小广延性、满足广义Hellmann-Feynman定理，在隔离双电子和双空穴极限下精确，计算规模为O(o²v⁴)，与CCSD相当。测试表明其反应能平均绝对偏差从OQVCCD的1.20降至0.81 kcal/mol，接近DCSD水平。
AI.motivation: OQVCCD方法在闭壳层反应能计算中误差较大（平均绝对偏差1.20 kcal/mol），且对角化问题可能带来收敛不稳定问题。作者希望通过施加DC近似来改善其精度，使其接近DCSD，同时保留OQVCCD的类厄米能量泛函等优良性质。
AI.method: 将可区分团簇（DC）近似应用于OQVCCD方法中，得到OQVDCD方法。该方法通过构建类厄米能量泛函，结合轨道优化策略，在保持大小广延性和广义Hellmann-Feynman定理的同时，将双激发振幅中的某些非物理项去除（DC近似），从而改善能量精度并保持O(o²v⁴)的计算复杂度。
AI.result: OQVDCD在闭壳层反应能测试中将平均绝对偏差从OQVCCD的1.20降至0.81 kcal/mol，接近DCSD水平。在强关联测试体系中，OQVDCD将能量向基准值靠拢，但收敛稳健性略逊于DCSD。
AI.conclusion: OQVDCD作为OQVCCD与DCSD之间的折中方法，在保持类厄米泛函等理论优点的同时显著改善了反应能精度，是一种有前景的平衡精度与计算代价的量子化学方法，但在强关联情形下的收敛稳健性仍需改进。

title: Interplay of nonrelativistic and relativistic spin splittings in altermagnets
summary: Despite their compensated magnetic moments, altermagnets (AMs) exhibit nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) that offers routes to spintronic functionality without relying on relativistic spin-orbit coupling. However, how NRSS influences relativistic phenomena remains largely unexplored. Here we show that NRSS plays a crucial role in reshaping the Rashba effect in AMs with broken inversion symmetry. Using a tight-binding model, we demonstrate that Rashba spin splitting, whose magnitude is typically limited by the strength of spin-orbit coupling, is governed by NRSS energy scales. The resulting Rashba bands combined with NRSS generate anomalously large charge-to-spin conversion with a Néel-vector-tunable spin polarization. First-principles calculations for the noncentrosymmetric AM GdAlSi corroborate the emergence of these effects in a real system. Our results reveal the interplay between nonrelativistic and relativistic effects in AMs and identify them as fertile platforms for spin-orbitronic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了交变磁体（AMs）中非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS）如何重塑Rashba效应。研究发现 Rashba 自旋劈裂的幅度受 NRSS 能标控制，而非传统的自旋轨道耦合强度，并在非中心对称交变磁体 GdAlSi 中通过第一性原理计算证实，揭示了 NRSS 与相对论效应之间的相互作用及其在自旋轨道电子学中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体因其补偿磁矩但具有非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS）而备受关注，但目前关于 NRSS 如何影响相对论现象（如 Rashba 效应）的研究几乎空白，作者希望填补这一空白并探索其在自旋电子学中的应用。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚模型理论分析，结合第一性原理计算对真实材料 GdAlSi 进行验证。重点分析非中心对称交变磁体中 NRSS 与 Rashba 效应的相互作用及其产生的自旋-电荷转换效应。
AI.result: 研究发现 Rashba 自旋劈裂的大小由 NRSS 能标决定，而非传统上认为的自旋轨道耦合强度。NRSS 与 Rashba 能带结合可产生异常大的电荷-自旋转换效率，且具有可通过 Néel 矢量调制的自旋极化方向。第一性原理计算在 GdAlSi 中证实了这些效应。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了交变磁体中非相对论与相对论效应的相互作用机制，表明交变磁体是自旋轨道电子学应用的理想平台，为发展基于 NRSS 调控 Rashba 效应的新型自旋电子器件奠定了理论基础。

title: On Transmission Function Amplitude and Phase Recovery in Multislice Electron Ptychography
summary: {Multislice electron ptychography commonly accounts for inelastic scattering by including an absorptive object potential in the reconstruction forward model that attenuates the elastic signal. However, it remains unclear how the reconstruction is quantitatively impacted by thermal scattering. Here, we use the quantum excitation of phonons (QEP) formalism, which explicitly separates elastic and inelastic (thermal diffuse) scattering within a single multislice propagation, to simulate four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D STEM) datasets of PbTiO$_3$ and SrTiO$_3$ and reconstruct their phase and amplitude. We find that reconstructions of the QEP total and elastic-only datasets are nearly indistinguishable across sample thicknesses from 11 to 40 nm and across atomic species, demonstrating that the reconstruction is largely insensitive to incoherent thermal diffuse scattering within the collected angular range. Reconstructions from multislice phase-only simulations further confirm that appreciable amplitude does not arise from multiple elastic scattering, but instead reflects attenuation of the coherent elastic signal due to thermal scattering. Further comparison of the QEP elastic-only reconstruction with absorptive multislice simulations reveals substantial amplitude contrast deviations for heavy Pb columns (up to 17\%), arising from the approximations used to evaluate the absorptive potential for the 4D STEM simulation. These results thus indicate that reconstruction phase and amplitude accuracy are not significantly limited by the absorptive potential forward model, even in the presence of thermal diffuse scattering.

AI.tldr: 本文使用量子声子激发(QEP)形式，将弹性和非弹性（热漫散射）散射在多层切片传播中显式分离，模拟PbTiO₃和SrTiO₃的4D STEM数据集并重建其相位和振幅。结果表明重建对非相干热漫散射基本不敏感，且振幅主要反映热散射导致的相干弹性信号衰减而非多次弹性散射。与吸收势模型对比发现重Pb柱振幅对比度偏差可达17%，但总体而言吸收势前向模型对重建精度限制不大。
AI.motivation: 多层切片电子叠层衍射（ptychography）通常通过引入吸收势来近似非弹性散射，但热散射对重建定量结果的影响尚不清楚，作者旨在明确这一影响程度。
AI.method: 采用QEP（量子声子激发）形式，在单个多层切片传播中显式分离弹性和非弹性热漫散射；模拟两种材料在不同厚度（11-40 nm）下的4D STEM数据集，并对比QEP总散射、弹性-only、多切片相位-only和吸收势多层切片模拟的重建结果。
AI.result: ①QEP总数据集与纯弹性数据集的重建几乎无法区分（各厚度、各原子种类均如此）；②相位-only模拟证实振幅并非来自多次弹性散射，而是热散射导致的相干信号衰减；③QEP纯弹性重建与吸收势模拟相比，重Pb柱的振幅对比度偏差最高达17%。
AI.conclusion: 热漫散射在所采集的角度范围内对重建影响很小，吸收势前向模型即使存在热漫散射也不会显著限制相位和振幅的重建精度。

title: Neural quantum states in condensed matter: advances, best practices, and prospects
summary: Neural quantum states provide flexible variational representations of quantum many-body wave functions by combining neural-network parametrizations with Monte Carlo sampling. In this perspective, we review recent advances in their application to condensed-matter systems, focusing on frustrated quantum magnets, interacting lattice fermions, and non-equilibrium dynamics. We discuss the architectures, symmetry constraints, optimization methods, and sampling strategies underlying state-of-the-art calculations, and summarize practical guidelines for reliable simulations. We also examine the principal remaining challenges, including learning non-trivial sign and phase structures, controlling variational bias, enforcing physical symmetries, scaling optimization to large networks, and achieving stable real-time evolution. Finally, we outline promising directions in which neural quantum states may extend the reach of classical simulations of strongly correlated quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述性观点文章，回顾了神经量子态（Neural Quantum States, NQS）在凝聚态物理中的应用，涵盖受挫量子磁体、相互作用晶格费米子和非平衡动力学等领域，讨论了架构、对称性约束、优化方法和采样策略，并总结了可靠模拟的实用指南及当前面临的主要挑战和未来方向。
AI.motivation: 强关联量子多体系统的经典模拟长期受到指数级希尔伯特空间维度的制约。神经量子态结合神经网络参数化与蒙特卡洛采样，为量子多体波函数提供了灵活的变分表示。本文旨在系统回顾该领域的最新进展，总结实用经验，识别当前瓶颈，为后续研究提供方向性指导。
AI.method: 本文采用综述视角，对神经量子态方法进行了系统性梳理：涵盖不同神经网络架构（如受限玻尔兹曼机和自回归模型）、物理对称性的植入方式、变分蒙特卡洛优化算法、采样策略等关键技术；同时通过对比不同应用场景（量子磁体、费米子体系、非平衡动力学）归纳出可靠模拟的实践准则，并对剩余挑战进行批判性分析。
AI.result: 论文总结了神经量子态在强关联量子多体系统模拟中已取得的显著进展，包括在受挫磁体和费米子系统中的成功应用；同时指出了若干核心未解挑战：学习非平凡符号和相位结构、控制变分偏差、强制物理对称性、大规模网络优化扩展以及稳定的实时演化等问题。
AI.conclusion: 神经量子态有望进一步拓展经典计算对强关联量子物质的模拟边界。未来需要在架构设计、符号学习、对称性约束和高效优化等方面持续突破，以应对量子多体模拟中的根本性困难。

title: Phase control of magnon-phonon coupling via magnetic field
summary: We study the phase of the coupling between magnons and surface acoustic wave (SAW) phonons in magnetic thin films. The coupling constant changes from a real to a complex number as the external magnetic field is reduced. Below a transition field, the imaginary coupling constant allows SAW phonons to couple to overdamped magnons whose resonance frequency is close to zero and far from the SAW resonance. The strength of the imaginary coupling constant and the magnitude of the transition field both scale with magnetic damping. We find the coupling produces a broad, pronounced minimum in the SAW transmittance spectrum near zero magnetic field in a Ni/Ru/Ni synthetic antiferromagnet with large magnetic damping. These results demonstrate that the phase of the complex magnon-phonon coupling constant can be tuned via magnetic field in strongly damped magnets, offering a platform to explore novel regimes of magnon-phonon interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了磁性薄膜中磁振子与表面声波（SAW）声子之间耦合常数的相位。研究发现，随着外磁场降低，耦合常数从实数变为复数。在转变场以下，虚耦合常数使SAW声子能够与过阻尼磁振子耦合（其共振频率接近零，远离SAW共振）。虚耦合常数的强度和转变场的大小均随磁阻尼标度变化。在具有大磁阻尼的Ni/Ru/Ni合成反铁磁体中，该耦合在近零磁场处产生了SAW透射谱中宽而显著的极小值。结果表明，在强阻尼磁体中可通过磁场调谐复磁振子-声子耦合常数的相位，为探索磁振子-声子相互作用的奇异机制提供了平台。
AI.motivation: 深入理解磁振子与SAW声子耦合的本质，特别是耦合常数从实数到复数的相位转变及其物理机制，探索在强阻尼磁体中调控磁振子-声子相互作用的新途径。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和实验测量相结合，研究不同磁场条件下Ni/Ru/Ni合成反铁磁体中磁振子-SAWP声子耦合常数的相位变化，分析耦合常数虚部与磁阻尼的关系，并测量SAW透射谱。
AI.result: 发现耦合常数随磁场降低从实数变为复数；虚耦合常数使声子耦合到过阻尼磁振子；虚耦合常数强度和转变场均与磁阻尼成比例；在Ni/Ru/Ni合成反铁磁体中观察到近零磁场处SAW透射谱的宽而显著的极小值。
AI.conclusion: 磁场可在强阻尼磁体中调谐复磁振子-声子耦合常数的相位，为探索磁振子-声子相互作用的新型物理机制提供了实验平台。

title: A differentiable photon-by-photon likelihood for continuous free-energy landscapes and diffusion coefficients from single-molecule FRET
summary: Single-molecule FRET probes the conformational dynamics of biomolecules by measuring the distance between two dyes. The experiment produces a stream of coloured photons, which is only an indirect readout of these dynamics. Recovering the free-energy landscape and diffusion coefficient from such a photon stream is a difficult inverse problem. Existing approaches assume a small number of discrete states, bin the photons, or are computationally expensive. Here we derive an exact likelihood for the recorded photon stream under a model in which the dye distance diffuses on a continuous free-energy landscape. It uses the raw inter-photon times and colours at full time resolution, and analytically integrates out all hidden trajectories. The likelihood is differentiable, so automatic differentiation returns exact gradients with respect to all model parameters. This lets us jointly infer the free-energy landscape, the diffusion coefficient, and the photophysical parameters by gradient-based optimization. On simulated data, we recover free-energy landscapes, including ones with a short-lived intermediate, together with the diffusion coefficients. Uncertainties follow from the curvature of the likelihood, computed directly from the same gradients. The framework also guides experimental design. Before any data are recorded, we can evaluate how much a given acquisition setting reduces the resulting uncertainty. Evaluation on the GPU is fast, and independent traces are processed in parallel, so a single fit converges in minutes and scales to large datasets. The likelihood extends photon-by-photon analysis to continuous free-energy landscapes and diffusion coefficients, putting fast quantitative inference with uncertainties within reach of the smFRET community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对单分子FRET实验的精确似然函数，该函数在连续自由能景观上模拟染料距离的扩散过程，利用原始光子间时间和颜色进行全时间分辨率分析，并通过自动微分实现梯度优化，从而联合推断自由能景观、扩散系数和光物理参数。
AI.motivation: 现有的smFRET数据分析方法存在局限性：要么假设少量离散状态，要么需要对光子进行分箱处理，要么计算代价高昂。从光子流中恢复自由能景观和扩散系数是一个困难的逆问题，迫切需要一种既能处理连续构象、又能保持全时间分辨率的高效推断方法。
AI.method: 推导了一个精确的似然函数，用于描述染料距离在连续自由能景观上扩散的光子流模型。该方法使用原始的光子间时间间隔和颜色，在全时间分辨率下工作，并解析地积分掉所有隐藏轨迹。似然函数是可微分的，通过自动微分返回所有模型参数的精确梯度，从而采用基于梯度的优化方法联合推断自由能景观、扩散系数和光物理参数。
AI.result: 在模拟数据上成功恢复了自由能景观（包括具有短寿命中间态的景观）以及扩散系数。不确定性可通过似然曲率直接计算。框架还能指导实验设计，在记录数据前评估给定采集设置对不确定性的影响。GPU上的评估速度快，独立轨迹可并行处理，单个拟合数分钟内收敛，可扩展至大规模数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该似然函数将光子级分析扩展到连续自由能景观和扩散系数，使smFRET领域能够进行快速且带不确定性的定量推断，为单分子实验数据分析提供了新的强大工具。

title: AutoMOOSE: Use Case and Logical Views of Agentic Phase-Field Simulation Software
summary: AutoMOOSE is an agentic software framework that converts a natural-language request into an executed, screened, and interpreted MOOSE phase-field simulation. Here, we deploy AutoMOOSE as a agentic software, complementing our prior work which focused on development of the agentic tool. We describe our software framework and architecture through Use Case and logical views of the 1+5 architectural-views model, covering its user roles, component structure, six-agent pipeline, physics plugin layer, Model Context Protocol interface, and screening/falsification/recovery loop. Our architecture separates physical falsification from automatic repair, so corrected simulations remain inspectable and must be re-admitted before acceptance. We focus on software design, extensibility, interoperability, and reuse of the AutoMoose framework for broad utilization in multiphysics materials design problems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AutoMOOSE，一个将自然语言请求转化为可执行、可筛选和可解释的MOOSE相场模拟的智能体软件框架，重点阐述了其软件架构设计。
AI.motivation: 在先前工作中已开发了AutoMOOSE智能体工具，本文旨在将其部署为完整的智能体软件，并系统性地描述其架构、可扩展性和可复用性，以支持广泛的多物理场材料设计问题。
AI.method: 采用1+5架构视图模型（Use Case视图和逻辑视图）描述软件框架，包括：用户角色、组件结构、六智能体流水线、物理插件层、Model Context Protocol接口，以及筛选/证伪/恢复循环。架构将物理证伪与自动修复分离，修正后的模拟需重新准入才能被接受。
AI.result: 本文主要贡献在于AutoMOOSE的软件设计、可扩展性、互操作性和复用性的系统化描述，而非新的物理或算法结果。
AI.conclusion: AutoMOOSE作为一个智能体软件框架，通过将证伪与修复分离、保证修正模拟的可检查性和可准入性，为多物理场材料设计提供了稳健且可扩展的自动化模拟框架。

title: Ultralow-Field Triplon Condensation in a Spin-Ladder Magnet
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures; Supplemental Material: 13 pages, 7 figures, 1 table
summary: We realise the first ultralow-field Bose-Einstein condensation of triplons in a spin-ladder magnet, uncovering a quantum critical point at only $μ_0 H_{c1}=0.17$ T in Henmilite ($\mathrm{Ca_2Cu(OH)_4[B(OH)_4]_2}$). Unlike dimer magnets, a ladder retains extended one-dimensional correlations in its gapped parent state, making this limit strongly fluctuation dominated. Thermodynamic, magnetoelastic, $μ$SR, and neutron-diffraction measurements overturn the previous assignment of zero-field antiferromagnetic order, establishing a quantum-disordered coupled-ladder parent state with persistent low-energy dynamics. The weak low-temperature anomaly instead marks a gap-controlled crossover from the correlated ladder regime into the activated quantum-disordered state. These measurements further reveal an exceptionally asymmetric ordered dome extending to $μ_0 H_{c2}\simeq 8.2$ T. Quantum Monte Carlo simulations for the relevant spin Hamiltonian place Henmilite just on the gapped side of the zero-field ladder-ordering instability, naturally accounting for the strong separation between the exchange and residual-gap scales and the tiny critical field. Our findings extend ultralow-field triplon condensation beyond the dimer paradigm and establish Henmilite as a platform for controlled tuning across quantum criticality in a fluctuation-dominated spin ladder.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在自旋梯磁体Henmilite中实现了triplon的超低场玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚，发现其量子临界点仅为0.17 T，推翻了先前关于零场反铁磁序的结论，确立了一个量子无序的耦合梯子母态，并通过量子蒙特卡洛模拟验证了Henmilite位于零场梯子有序不稳定性的能隙一侧。
AI.motivation: 以往triplon凝聚现象均在二聚体磁体中研究，而梯子磁体因其保留了一维关联的扩展性质，在能隙母态中波动效应更强，具有不同于二聚体范式的物理特性。作者希望探索超低场下triplon凝聚能否拓展到梯子体系，并澄清Henmilite零场基态的真实性质。
AI.method: 综合运用热力学测量、磁弹性测量、μSR和中子衍射等多种实验手段，并结合量子蒙特卡洛模拟，对Henmilite的磁性基态、临界场和有序相图进行系统表征。
AI.result: 确定了超低临界场μ₀H_c1=0.17 T，修正了零场基态为量子无序耦合梯子态而非反铁磁序；发现高度不对称的有序圆顶延伸至μ₀H_c2≃8.2 T；QMC模拟确认Henmilite位于零场梯子有序不稳定性的能隙侧。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将超低场triplon凝聚从二聚体范式拓展到自旋梯体系，确立了Henmilite作为在波动主导的自旋梯中精确调控量子临界性的理想平台。

title: Towards Ultra Scalability of Non-Volatile Magnetic Tunnel Junctions with a 3D Storage Layer
summary: The perpendicular Spin Transfer Torque Magnetic Random Access Memory is one of the most promising emerging non-volatile memory technologies, based on ultra-thin magnetic tunnel junctions. However, as these devices are limited by their thermal stability factor at technological nodes smaller than 20 nm, their scalability is compromised. A possible solution to this limitation relies on taking advantage of the shape anisotropy, by increasing substantially the thickness of the storage layer. Thanks to the combination of a vertical aspect-ratio and enhanced volume, high thermal stability can be maintained at sub-10 nm nodes. Here, we present the technological advancements and understanding of the magnetisation reversal that led to faster switching speeds at reduced switching voltage, providing a viable approach for dense arrays of ultra-small magnetic tunnel junctions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了垂直自旋转移矩磁随机存取存储器（p-STT-MRAM）在小于20nm技术节点面临的热稳定性限制问题，提出通过增加存储层厚度并利用形状各向异性来维持亚10nm节点的高热稳定性，并展示了实现更快开关速度和更低开关电压的技术进展。
AI.motivation: p-STT-MRAM是最有前景的新型非易失性存储器技术之一，基于超薄磁性隧道结。然而在小于20nm的技术节点，其热稳定性因子受限，导致可扩展性受损，急需解决方案。
AI.method: 通过显著增加存储层厚度，利用形状各向异性与垂直高宽比和增强体积相结合，在亚10nm节点维持高热稳定性，并优化磁化反转机制以实现更快的开关速度和更低的开关电压。
AI.result: 展示了技术进展和对磁化反转的理解，实现了更快的开关速度、更低的开关电压，为超小磁性隧道结的高密度阵列提供了可行方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过增加存储层厚度的形状各向异性方案，为亚10nm节点p-STT-MRAM的可扩展性提供了可行途径，支持超小尺寸磁性隧道结的高密度存储阵列应用。

title: Intracavity Photon Statistics from Correlated Molecular Electronic Structure
summary: Quantum optics characterizes light through photon correlations, but ab initio cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) has only calculated raw field moments at present. In this study, intracavity photon statistics of cavity-coupled molecules are computed from QED coupled-cluster (QED-CCSD-22) densities and validated against exact diagonalization of the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian. A change of coordinate origin or dipole convention displaces the ground state coherently, so second-order and higher cumulants of the cavity field are well defined even for molecular ions. The photon subsystem of QED Hartree-Fock is exactly coherent, so the invariant statistics measure electron-photon correlation. The field fluctuations are super-Poissonian, and their degree of second-order coherence is set by the cavity frequency rather than by the coupling strength, falling from 18.5 to 4.9 for H2 as the cavity is detuned from 5 to 20 eV. A parity selection rule makes the sign of the third cumulant a probe of the orientation of the molecular charge asymmetry along the cavity polarization.

AI.tldr: 本文利用QED耦合簇方法（QED-CCSD-22）计算了腔内耦合分子的光子统计性质，并通过精确对角化Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量进行验证。研究发现腔场涨落呈超泊松分布，其二阶相干度由腔频率而非耦合强度决定，且三阶累积量的符号可通过宇称选择规则探测分子电荷不对称性沿腔偏振方向的方向。
AI.motivation: 量子光学通过光子关联来表征光，但现有的从头算腔量子电动力学（QED）方法仅能计算原始场矩，无法获得腔内光子的统计分布信息。为了弥合量子光学与从头算QED之间的鸿沟，需要发展从量子化学密度中提取光子统计量的方法。
AI.method: 从QED-CCSD-22密度出发计算腔内光子统计量，并通过精确对角化Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量进行验证。分析坐标原点和偶极子约定的变化对基态相干位移的影响，利用QED Hartree-Fock的光子子系统精确相干性，将不变统计量作为电子-光子关联的度量。
AI.result: 腔内场涨落呈超泊松分布；对于H2分子，腔从5电子伏特失谐到20电子伏特时，二阶相干度从18.5降至4.9，表明该量由腔频率决定而非耦合强度。三阶累积量的符号可作为分子电荷不对称性取向的探针。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了从从头算QED密度中提取腔内光子统计量的理论框架，揭示了腔场超泊松统计特性与腔频率的依赖关系，并提出利用宇称选择规则和三阶累积量探测分子电荷分布的取向信息。

title: Machine Learning Guided Discovery of Corundum High Entropy Oxides
summary: Early thinking in the field of high entropy oxides (HEOs) emphasized their likely abundance, with combinatorial arguments hinting at a myriad of new materials. The experimental reality has proven more challenging: the stability of HEOs cannot be straightforwardly predicted based on ionic radii, lattice geometry, and charge-balancing considerations alone. In this work, we employ machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) to predict the synthesizability of HEOs of the form $A_2$O$_3$ derived from a selection of trivalent cations. From nearly 500 possible compositions, we identify 16 promising candidates for experimental validation with solid-state and combustion synthesis. We discover three new HEOs in the corundum structure, including (Al,Cr,Fe,Rh,Sc)$_2$O$_3$, and one novel cation-ordered phase, (Al,Fe,Ga,Sc)$_2$O$_3$. By far the most common synthesis outcome was a mixture of competing phases, sometimes involving redox reactions. Our results also reveal profound synthesis method dependence for the final product, where qualitatively equivalent outcomes between the two synthesis methods were only observed for 3 of the 16 tested compositions. We conclude that the occurrence rate of HEOs is far rarer than initially believed and that machine learning approaches can effectively guide us to the "needle in the haystack".

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）预测A₂O₃型高熵氧化物（HEOs）的可合成性，从近500种可能的组合中筛选出16个候选材料进行实验验证，成功发现了3种刚玉结构的新型HEOs和1种阳离子有序相。研究发现HEOs的实际出现率远低于早期理论预测，且合成方法对最终产物有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 早期高熵氧化物领域基于组合逻辑推测存在大量潜在的新材料，但实验现实证明仅凭离子半径、晶格几何和电荷平衡等传统因素难以准确预测HEOs的稳定性。因此需要更有效的方法来筛选和预测可合成的高熵氧化物。
AI.method: 使用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）对近500种可能的A₂O₃型高熵氧化物组合进行合成可行性预测，从中筛选出16个最有希望的候选材料，并通过固相合成和燃烧合成两种方法进行实验验证。
AI.result: 成功合成出3种刚玉结构的新型HEOs，包括(Al,Cr,Fe,Rh,Sc)₂O₃，以及1种新型阳离子有序相(Al,Fe,Ga,Sc)₂O₃。最常见的合成结果是竞争相的混合物（有时涉及氧化还原反应）。此外，16种测试组合中仅3种在两种合成方法下得到定性等效的结果，表明合成方法对产物有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 高熵氧化物的实际出现率远比最初预期的要稀有得多，机器学习方法可以有效地指导研究人员在该领域中找到"大海捞针"般的目标材料。

title: Long-lived Laughlin pairs in a depleted quantum Hall edge channel
summary: On-demand sources and mesoscopic beam splitters allow individual ballistic electrons to collide in depleted quantum Hall edge channels, where their unscreened Coulomb interaction acts as a strong, controllable nonlinearity. Theory suggests a more striking possibility: in a strong magnetic field, the repulsion can drive quantized relative circulation, allowing two electrons to propagate together as a positive-energy Laughlin pair. The relevance of such pairs to experiment depends on quantitative lifetimes in realistic guiding potentials and on whether the proposed collision pathway to pair formation survives full two-dimensional dynamics. We develop a microscopic theory of quasibound Laughlin pairs using the physical two-electron Hamiltonian. For a general local electric-field gradient, we determine the dissociation threshold, number of quasibound states, and decay rates. Complex scaling and analytic tunneling theory show that lifetimes grow exponentially with pair energy above threshold. Applied to reported GaAs parameters, the theory indicates that existing devices may already support the lowest spin-polarized pair, with a leading lifetime estimate about three orders of magnitude longer than typical propagation times. We simulate a collision with the full finite-field Hamiltonian, demonstrating both a framework for nonlinear two-electron quantum dynamics and the creation of a Laughlin pair in a representative two-electron collision. We use Husimi distributions and their zeros to visualize both quasibound resonances and transient collision states in phase space. These results place the preparation, propagation, and detection of repulsively paired electrons within reach of existing single-electron circuit technology. They identify kinematic stabilization under constrained one-dimensional propagation as a pairing mechanism that may extend to anyonic quantum Hall edge excitations.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了准束缚Laughlin对的微观理论，利用物理双电子哈密顿量计算了其解离阈值、束缚态数目和衰变率，并通过复标度和解析遂穿理论证明寿命随能量指数增长。针对GaAs参数，理论表明现有器件可支持最低自旋极化对，寿命比典型传播时间长约三个数量级。全有限场哈密顿量的碰撞模拟展示了双电子非线性量子动力学框架与Laughlin对的产生，并通过Husimi分布可视化相空间中的共振和瞬态碰撞态。
AI.motivation: 理论预言强磁场中电子排斥力可驱动量子化相对环绕，使两个电子以正能量的Laughlin对形式共同传播，但其实验相关性取决于现实引导势中的定量寿命以及所提议的碰撞成对路径是否能在完整二维动力学中成立。
AI.method: 基于物理双电子哈密顿量发展准束缚Laughlin对的微观理论；使用复标度（complex scaling）和解析遂穿理论计算解离阈值、束缚态数目及衰变率；通过全有限场哈密顿量的碰撞模拟验证碰撞成对路径；利用Husimi分布及其零点可视化相空间中的准束缚共振与瞬态碰撞态。
AI.result: 寿命随对能量（阈值以上）指数增长；应用于GaAs参数时，现有器件已可能支持最低自旋极化Laughlin对，寿命估计比典型传播时间长约三个数量级；模拟展示了双电子非线性量子动力学框架并成功在代表性碰撞中产生Laughlin对。
AI.conclusion: 排斥配对电子的制备、传播和探测已处于现有单电子电路技术可及范围之内；研究识别出受约束一维传播下的运动学稳定化（kinematic stabilization）作为一种配对机制，可能扩展到任意子量子霍尔边缘激发。

title: Machine-Learned NMR Shieldings in Molecular Solids with Built-In Hybrid-Functional Molecular Corrections
summary: Fast and accurate chemical shielding estimators are essential for shielding-driven Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) crystallography. Machine-learning models for shielding predictions have matured significantly and today are primarily limited by the electronic structure reference data they are trained on. Here, we introduce ShiftML4, a shielding-tensor model trained directly on monomer-corrected calculations that approximate PBE0, rather than the PBE reference targeted by earlier ShiftML models. ShiftML4 is trained on a diverse set of structures containing 12 of the most common NMR nuclei in molecular organic solids. On experimental benchmark sets, the 13C isotropic RMSE against experiment is 1.67 ppm, compared with 2.34 ppm for GIPAW-PBE on the same geometries. ShiftML4 gives a similar 1H prediction RMSE to ShiftML3 (0.5 ppm) and improves the 15N RMSE from 7.24 to 6.08 ppm. The model also reduces errors in the shielding-tensor anisotropy, with an RMSE of 4.63 ppm on 13C CSA principal components against 5.85 ppm for GIPAW. The improvements in prediction accuracy are retained on better geometries. Basing shift predictions on structures relaxed with PET-MOLS, a recent machine-learned interatomic potential that reaches approximate hybrid-DFT geometries in seconds, lowers the ShiftML4 errors further to 0.48 ppm (1H), 1.49 ppm (13C) and 3.66 ppm (15N).

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ShiftML4，一个用于NMR结晶学的化学屏蔽张量机器学习模型。该模型直接以近似PBE0的单体校正计算训练（而非早期ShiftML模型的PBE参考），涵盖12种常见NMR核。在实验基准上，13C各向同性RMSE为1.67 ppm（优于GIPAW-PBE的2.34 ppm），1H预测与ShiftML3相当（0.5 ppm），15N从7.24改善至6.08 ppm，屏蔽张量各向异性误差也显著降低。结合PET-MOLS机器学习势能面优化的结构后，精度进一步提升（1H：0.48，13C：1.49，15N：3.66 ppm）。
AI.motivation: NMR结晶学需要快速准确的化学屏蔽估计器。尽管ML屏蔽预测模型已成熟，但其精度主要受限于训练所用的电子结构参考数据（早期模型使用PBE级别参考）。作者希望将训练参考提升到更准确的近似混合泛函（PBE0）级别，以突破这一瓶颈并提升预测精度。
AI.method: 训练一个名为ShiftML4的屏蔽张量模型，直接以单体校正的PBE0近似计算作为参考标签（替代PBE），使用包含12种常见NMR核的多样化分子有机固体结构进行训练；同时配合PET-MOLS机器学习原子间势对结构进行松弛以获得更好的几何结构。
AI.result: 在实验基准上，13C各向同性RMSE为1.67 ppm（优于GIPAW-PBE的2.34 ppm）；1H RMSE与ShiftML3持平（0.5 ppm）；15N RMSE从7.24降至6.08 ppm；13C CSA主成分RMSE为4.63 ppm（低于GIPAW的5.85 ppm）。配合PET-MOLS优化结构后，误差进一步降至1H 0.48、13C 1.49、15N 3.66 ppm。
AI.conclusion: 通过将训练参考从PBE升级到近似PBE0级别（并配合更好的ML势能面结构优化），ShiftML4在多个核素的IS、张量各向异性预测上显著超越现有方法（包括GIPAW-PBE），表明提升参考电子结构级别是进一步提高ML屏蔽预测精度的关键路径。

title: Orbital-Selective Spin Splitting in the Altermagnetic Ti$_2$XX' Monolayers
summary: Altermagnets have attracted intensive attention recently, owing to their unique combination of zero net magnetic moment of antiferromagnets and momentum space spin-splitting of ferromagnets. Herein, we systematically explore monolayer altermagnetic Ti$_2$XX' (X/X' = F, Cl, Br, I) materials for novel electronic properties. Especifically, spin-splitting exists in the valence bands of all studied materials, whereas several compositions exhibit nearly spin-degenerate conduction bands near the Fermi level, which is markedly different from conventional altermagnets. This phenomenon can be attributed to the bond-angle-sensitive super-exchange occurring in the $d_{xz}$ or $d_{yz}$ orbitals, while the super-exchange of the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbital is not sensitive to the Ti-X-Ti bond angle. Motivated by this intriguing phenomenon, Fermi level modulation via doping or heterostructure construction enables the transition between two electronic states, endowing these materials great application potential in information storage devices.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了单层交替磁体Ti₂XX'（X/X' = F, Cl, Br, I）材料的电子性质，发现在价带中所有材料均存在自旋劈裂，但部分材料在费米能级附近表现出近简并的导带，这一现象归因于不同轨道的超交换对键角的敏感性差异，并通过掺杂或异质结构建可实现电子态调控。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体因其兼具反铁磁体的零净磁矩和铁磁体的动量空间自旋劈裂特性而备受关注，探索新型交替磁体材料及其独特的电子性质具有重要意义。
AI.method: 对单层交替磁体Ti₂XX'（X/X' = F, Cl, Br, I）材料进行系统研究，分析其自旋劈裂行为，并通过轨道分辨的超交换机制解释导带近简并现象，利用掺杂或异质结构建实现费米能级调控。
AI.result: 所有研究材料的价带均存在自旋劈裂，但部分成分的导带在费米能级附近近乎自旋简并；d_xz或d_yz轨道的超交换对Ti-X-Ti键角敏感，而d_x²-y²轨道的超交换对键角不敏感，这解释了观察到的差异现象。
AI.conclusion: 通过掺杂或异质结构建可实现费米能级调制，从而在两种电子态之间转换，使这些材料在信息存储器件中具有巨大的应用潜力。

title: Quasi-one-dimensional topological band structure and van Hove singularities in monolayer TaIrTe$_4$ from laser $μ$-ARPES
summary: Recent transport experiments reported a quantum spin Hall insulator phase in monolayer 1T-TaIrTe$_4$ gated away from charge neutrality. This phase is not predicted by band structure calculations and has been attributed to an electronic instability induced by strong correlations at a putative van Hove singularity. Here, we investigate the electronic structure of exfoliated monolayer 1T-TaIrTe$_4$ using micro-focus laser angle resolved photoemission. We find a strongly anisotropic band structure susceptible to density wave instabilities. Our data further reveal a saddle point singularity in the density of states. However, we find that the saddle point lies at a density for which transport experiments found no anomalies. Moreover, the quasiparticle line widths suggest weak electron correlations only. This points to a secondary role of van Hove singularities and electron correlations in the transport phase diagram of monolayer 1T-TaIrTe$_4$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微聚焦激光角分辨光电子能谱研究了单层1T-TaIrTe₄的电子结构，发现其能带具有很强的各向异性，并存在一个鞍点奇异性，但该鞍点位于输运实验中无异常的载流子密度处，且准粒子线宽表明电子关联很弱。这表明van Hove奇点和电子关联在该材料的输运相图中仅起次要作用。
AI.motivation: 近期输运实验报道了远离电荷中性点的单层1T-TaIrTe₄中观测到量子自旋霍尔绝缘体相，但这一相无法由能带结构计算预测，被归因于假定的van Hove奇点处强关联诱导的电子不稳定性。作者希望从实验角度直接检验这一假说，弄清该相的真实物理起源。
AI.method: 采用微聚焦激光角分辨光电子能谱（micro-focus laser ARPES）对剥离的单层1T-TaIrTe₄进行电子结构测量，分析能带的各向异性、态密度中的鞍点奇异性以及准粒子线宽，以此评估电子关联强度和van Hove奇点的作用。
AI.result: 实验发现该材料具有强各向异性的能带结构，容易产生密度波不稳定性；态密度中确实存在鞍点奇异性。然而，该鞍点对应的载流子密度与输运实验中发现异常的密度不一致。此外，准粒子线宽表明电子关联较弱。
AI.conclusion: van Hove奇性和电子关联在单层1T-TaIrTe₄的输运相图中仅起次要作用，之前将量子自旋霍尔绝缘体相归因于van Hove奇点处强关联驱动的电子不稳定性这一假设可能并不成立，需要重新审视该相的物理机制。

title: Dissipation driven boundary localization in higher order topological insulators
summary: We study dissipation driven boundary localization in a Bernevig Hughes Zhang type second order topological insulator by introducing inhomogeneous, spin dependent boundary dissipation. After projection onto the edge subspace, the dominant component of the boundary dissipation lies in the same Pauli channel as the kinetic term. This channel gives both counter-propagating edge modes the same real transfer exponent. The two modes therefore accumulate at the same dissipative domain wall. For the corner states, the dissipative envelope competes with Jackiw Rebbi localization. Increasing dissipation moves their weight from the geometric corners to the dissipative domain wall. Propagating edge states also localize at this wall. Numerical calculations confirm the qualitative predictions of the edge theory. A fixed energy Feshbach reduction captures finite size effects. Inhomogeneous boundary dissipation thus controls boundary state localization without changing the bulk topology.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang型二阶拓扑绝缘体中由耗散驱动的边界局域化。通过引入不均匀的自旋相关边界耗散，投影到边缘子空间后发现边界耗散与动能项处于同一Pauli通道，使得两个反向传播的边缘模式获得相同的实传递指数，从而在相同的耗散畴壁处累积。角态的耗散包络与Jackiw-Rebbi局域化竞争，增加耗散会将权重从几何角转移到耗散畴壁。传播边缘态也在该壁处局域化。数值计算证实了边缘理论的定性预测，固定能量Feshbach约简捕捉了有限尺寸效应。不均匀边界耗散在不改变体拓扑的情况下控制边界态局域化。

AI.method: 论文采用投影到边缘子空间的理论分析方法，结合数值计算验证。具体包括：在BHZ型二阶拓扑绝缘体中引入不均匀的、自旋相关的边界耗散；通过边缘子空间投影识别主导耗散通道；应用固定能量Feshbach约简方法处理有限尺寸效应。
AI.result: 边界耗散的主导分量与动能项处于同一Pauli通道，赋予两个反向传播边缘模式相同的实传递指数，使两者在相同耗散畴壁处累积。角态中耗散包络与Jackiw-Rebbi局域化相互竞争，增加耗散使角态权重从几何角移至耗散畴壁。数值结果验证了边缘理论的定性预测。
