title: Machine learning predictions of the Hessian matrix for peptides chains and small proteins
summary: Molecular Hessians have a key role in describing molecular vibrations, trajectories and optimization paths. An explicit calculation of them through standard quantum mechanical methods can be computationally expensive for medium-large systems, and in many applications not even needed. Machine learning methods can be a shortcut to tackle efficiently the computational difficulties. This paper will present a ML model able to predict the Hessian matrix of biological system made of thousands of atoms. The method, based on learning the Hessian in internal coordinates is intrinsically invariant to molecular rotations and translations, and has a very good scaling with the systems' size. The training was performed on a dataset of simple aminoacids, as they constitute the building blocks of larger proteins. From the predicted Hessian matrix it is possible to calculate thermochemical properties within the harmonic approximations, among them enthalpies, entropies, Gibbs' free energies, and zero point vibrational energies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的模型，用于预测由数千个原子组成的生物系统的Hessian矩阵（分子振动曲率矩阵）。该方法在内部坐标系中学习Hessian矩阵，天然具有对分子旋转和平移的不变性，且具有良好的系统规模扩展性。模型在简单氨基酸数据集上训练（作为更大蛋白质的基本构建单元），并可从中计算热化学性质，如焓、熵、吉布斯自由能和零点振动能。
AI.motivation: 分子Hessian矩阵在描述分子振动、轨迹和优化路径中起关键作用，但通过标准量子力学方法显式计算对中等至大型系统而言计算成本高昂，且在许多应用场景中并不完全必要。因此需要一种高效的替代方法。
AI.method: 使用机器学习模型预测Hessian矩阵，核心策略是在内部坐标系中学习Hessian，从而内在保证对分子旋转和平移的不变性，并实现良好的系统规模扩展性。训练数据集由简单氨基酸组成。
AI.result: 模型能够预测数千原子规模生物系统的Hessian矩阵，并在此基础上通过谐振近似计算热化学性质，包括焓、熵、吉布斯自由能和零点振动能。
AI.conclusion: 该ML方法为计算大型生物分子的Hessian矩阵提供了一条高效的捷径，避免了昂贵的量子力学显式计算，同时保持了物理对称性并通过谐振近似实现热化学性质的预测。

title: Magnetic-Field Selection of Magnetic Order in Altermagnets and Noncollinear Antiferromagnets
summary: Conventional field selection of magnetic order relies on the Zeeman coupling, which, however, vanishes in magnets without net magnetization, a rapidly growing class including altermagnets (AMs), noncollinear antiferromagnets (nc-AFMs), and PT-symmetric antiferromagnets (PT-AFMs). Here we show that the quantity that fundamentally couples a magnet to a uniform magnetic field is not the magnetization, but the binary order parameter eta that labels the two time-reversal-related minima of the Landau free energy. We develop a Landau theory of order selection based on eta under the constraints of magnetic point-group (MPG) symmetry, in which eta couples to odd-degree polynomials in the magnetic field. Within this framework, the linear term is the ferromagnetic Zeeman coupling, while higher-order couplings with leading degree n = 3, 5, 7, and 9 naturally appear in AMs and nc-AFMs. In contrast, combined PT symmetry forbids any such coupling. Consequently, it is the order-(n-1) magnetic susceptibility, rather than the net magnetization, that serves as the primary experimental observable for identifying the magnetic order of AMs and nc-AFMs. For all 122 MPGs, we classify the leading coupling degree and the corresponding polynomial forms. We demonstrate our framework in two representative materials: the AM MnF2 and the nc-AFM MnTe2. We further construct a symmetry-allowed spin model for an AM system to reveal the microscopic origin of the higher-order coupling and establish the coupling coefficient explicitly in terms of the spin-model parameters. Our work unifies the description of magnetic-order selection across magnets with and without net magnetization, offers a microscopic origin for this counterintuitive physics, and provides fingerprints for distinguishing intrinsic field selection from extrinsic switching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的朗道理论框架，用以描述磁场对磁有序的选择机制。作者指出，与均匀磁场耦合的基本量并非磁化强度，而是标记时间反演相关两个极小值的二元序参量η。该理论统一了具有净磁化与无净磁化的磁性材料（包括交替磁体和非共线反铁磁体）中的磁有序选择，并提供了微观起源和实验指纹。
AI.motivation: 传统的磁场选择磁有序依赖于塞曼耦合，但这一机制在无净磁化材料（如交替磁体AMs、非共线反铁磁体nc-AFMs和PT对称反铁磁体PT-AFMs）中消失。随着这类材料的重要性日益增长，亟需一种不依赖磁化强度的统一理论框架来描述磁场对这些磁有序的选择作用。
AI.method: 作者基于磁点群（MPG）对称性约束，发展了一套以二元序参量η为核心的朗道理论。η与磁场奇次多项式耦合：线性项对应铁磁塞曼耦合，而更高阶项（n=3,5,7,9）自然出现在AMs和nc-AFMs中。作者对所有122个磁点群分类了主导耦合阶次及对应多项式形式，并通过自旋模型揭示了高阶耦合的微观起源。
AI.result: 论文证明了对于AMs和nc-AFMs，实验上识别磁有序的主要可观测量是阶数(n-1)的磁化率而非净磁化强度。通过对所有122个MPG的分类，给出了各对称性下的主导耦合阶次和多项式形式，并以MnF2（AM）和MnTe2（nc-AFM）两个代表性材料进行了验证。此外，通过自旋模型建立了耦合系数与自旋模型参数的显式关系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作统一了有无净磁化磁体中的磁有序选择描述，为这一反直觉物理提供了微观起源，并为区分本征场选择与外禀切换提供了指纹特征，对无净磁化磁性材料的实验研究和应用具有重要意义。

title: Interedge backscattering in quantum spin Hall-based NS and SNS junctions
comment: 9+6 pages and 5+7 figures, comments are welcome
summary: We investigate the microscopic conditions that allow for the coupling between opposite quantum spin Hall (QSH) edges in hybrid junctions with superconductors. Using a microscopic Bernevig--Hughes--Zhang model and the Bogoliubov--de Gennes formalism, we model a potential barrier along the NS interface and identify the parameter regimes in which the QSH edges are coupled. In normal--superconductor junctions, such coupling manifests as deviations from the quantized zero-bias Andreev conductance $G=4e^2/h$. These deviations are controlled by the induced gap in the barrier, the barrier geometry, the interface transparency, orbital and Fermi-velocity mismatch, and disorder strength as well as the bias voltage leading to a zero-bias peak. We then analyze the impact of this interedge-coupling mechanism in Josephson junctions at equilibrium and show that it hybridizes the edge-resolved Andreev branches, opens gaps at the time-reversal-invariant phase differences $\varphi=0$ and $\varphi=π$, and modifies the superconducting quantum interference pattern. In a reflection-symmetric geometry, the relative sizes of the two gap openings provide complementary information about the interedge dynamical phase, which also determines the parity of the suppressed lobes in the magnetic interference pattern. This investigation sheds light on the microscopic details that control the coupling of helical edge states in actual devices and the resulting consequences for superconducting hybrid systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用微观BHZ模型和BdG形式，研究超导混合结中量子自旋霍尔（QSH）边缘态之间的耦合机制，揭示了其在正常-超导结和约瑟夫森结中的可观测效应，如偏离量子化的安德烈夫电导、能隙开启以及磁干涉图案的奇偶调制。
AI.motivation: 理解QSH边缘态在超导混合器件中耦合的微观条件，因为这种耦合会破坏边缘态的理想拓扑性质，实际器件中的退相干效应和各类失配参数对其影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用微观Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang模型，结合Bogoliubov-de Gennes形式论，在NS界面建模势垒，系统扫描各参数区间（诱导能隙、势垒几何、界面透明性、轨道与费米速度失配、无序强度、偏压）以识别边缘态耦合的条件，并进一步在约瑟夫森结中分析该耦合机制的影响。
AI.result: 识别出QSH边缘耦合的参数区间；耦合导致零偏置安德烈夫电导偏离4e²/h；在约瑟夫森结中，边缘分辨的安德烈夫支被杂化，在φ=0和φ=π处开启能隙，且反射对称几何下两个能隙的相对大小可提供边缘间动力学相位信息，该相位决定磁干涉图案中抑制瓣的奇偶性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究阐明了实际器件中控制螺旋边缘态耦合的微观细节及其对超导混合系统的后果，为理解真实QSH器件的输运行为提供了微观基础。

title: Prediction of a layer nonlinear Hall effect in bilayer nonmagnetic or antiferromagnetic systems
summary: Nonlinear Hall effects provide a powerful probe of quantum geometry in solids and enable rectification phenomena beyond the constraints of linear response. In this Letter, we predict a \emph{layer nonlinear Hall effect} (LNHE) in stacked bilayer systems composed of nonmagnetic or antiferromagnetic materials with a vanishing linear Hall conductivity. In such systems, the second- or third-order nonlinear Hall responses are intrinsically layer odd: the contributions from the two constituent layers have equal magnitude but opposite sign, resulting in exact cancellation under layer-exchange symmetry. An out-of-plane electric field $E_z$ can break this symmetry, thereby unveiling the hidden response and converting it into a switchable macroscopic nonlinear Hall signal. Using a minimal $k\!\cdot\!p$ model, we demonstrate that the LNHE can originate from the Berry curvature dipole mechanism. A systematic symmetry analysis of all 80 layer groups further yields a complete classification of the symmetry constraints and stacking configurations that allow for this type of LNHE. Beyond this mechanism, additional symmetry analysis reveals that LNHE may also arise from quantum metric dipole or inversed mass dipole. Remarkably, even in cases where second-order nonlinear Hall responses are symmetry forbidden, a third-order LNHE can still survive in certain stacked bilayer configurations. First-principles calculations on representative bilayers---nonmagnetic 1T$'$-WTe$_2$ and 1T$'$-ReS$_2$---explicitly demonstrate electrically reversible second-order LNHE, in full agreement with our symmetry-based predictions. Overall, our results establish LNHE as a universal phenomenon in a wide range of layered quantum materials and provide a robust route toward electrically tunable nonlinear transport.

AI.tldr: 本文预测了一种"层非线性霍尔效应"(LNHE)，在由非磁性或反铁磁材料组成的堆叠双层体系中，二阶或三阶非线性霍尔响应具有固有的层奇性——两层贡献大小相等但符号相反，在层交换对称性下完全抵消。外加垂直电场可以打破这种对称性，将隐藏的响应转换为可切换的宏观非线性霍尔信号。通过k·p模型展示了Berry曲率偶极子机制，并对80个层群进行了系统对称性分析，首次原理计算在1T'-WTe₂和1T'-ReS₂双层体系中验证了电可逆的二阶LNHE。
AI.motivation: 非线性霍尔效应是探测固体中量子几何的有力工具，但现有研究多集中于线性霍尔电导非零的体系。层状双层材料中是否可能存在一种由层间对称性控制、可被电场开关的隐藏非线性霍尔效应，此前尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 作者使用最小k·p模型证明了LNHE可由Berry曲率偶极子机制产生；对全部80个层群进行了完整对称性分析，分类了允许LNHE的对称性约束和堆叠构型；进一步对称性分析揭示了LNHE也可源于量子度量偶极子或反转质量偶极子；对1T'-WTe₂和1T'-ReS₂双层体系进行了第一性原理计算验证。
AI.result: 证明了在层交换对称性下两层非线性霍尔贡献精确抵消；外电场E_z可打破该对称性从而显露并开关LNHE；二阶LNHE被对称性禁止时三阶LNHE在某些堆叠双层中仍可存活；第一性原理计算在非磁性1T'-WTe₂和1T'-ReS₂双层中明确展示了电可逆的二阶LNHE，与对称性预测完全一致。
AI.conclusion: LNHE是广泛的层状量子材料中的普适现象，为电可调非线性输运提供了稳健的途径，拓展了非线性霍尔效应在量子几何探测和整流现象方面的应用范围。

title: Optical conductivity signature of Van Hove singularity in altermagnetic topological systems
summary: We investigate the topological phases, joint density of states (JDOS), optical conductivities, and magneto-optical responses of a two-dimensional $d$-wave altermagnet with spin-orbit coupling and Zeeman splitting. The system hosts Dirac gaps at the high-symmetry points $Γ$, $\textrm{M}$, $\textrm{X}$, and $\textrm{Y}$. We show that the JDOS exhibits kinks at the corresponding Dirac gap frequencies and pronounced peaks at Van Hove singularities, whose positions can be tuned by the altermagnetic order. These features are reflected in the optical conductivities, with complementary signatures in their real and imaginary parts. Particularly, the Van Hove signatures in the transverse optical conductivity disappear in the absence of $d$-wave altermagnetism, revealing an altermagnet-induced optical signature of the Van Hove singularity. Finally, the Faraday and Kerr rotations inherit characteristic features of the optical conductivity. Our results establish optical and magneto-optical spectroscopy as sensitive probes of Dirac gaps and Van Hove singularities in altermagnetic topological systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有自旋轨道耦合和塞曼分裂的二维d波交错磁体（altermagnet）中的拓扑相、联合态密度、光学电导率和磁光响应。系统在Γ、M、X和Y高对称点存在狄拉克能隙，JDOS在这些能隙频率处出现扭结，在范霍夫奇点处出现峰值，且可通过交错磁序调控。横向光导率中的范霍夫特征在无d波交错磁性时消失，揭示了一种交错磁体诱导的光学特征。法拉第和克尔旋转继承了光学电导率的特征，证明光学和磁光光谱是探测交错磁体拓扑系统中狄拉克能隙和范霍夫奇点的灵敏探针。
AI.motivation: 探索二维d波交错磁体中拓扑相与光学/磁光响应的关系，建立光谱学手段作为探测交错磁体拓扑特征（狄拉克能隙、范霍夫奇点）的灵敏工具。
AI.method: 理论研究二维d波交错磁体（含自旋轨道耦合和塞曼分裂），分析其拓扑相、联合态密度（JDOS）、光学电导率及磁光响应（法拉第和克尔旋转）。
AI.result: JDOS在狄拉克能隙频率处呈现扭结，在范霍夫奇点处呈现可调谐的显著峰值；光学电导率实部和虚部反映这些特征；横向光导率中的范霍夫特征依赖于d波交错磁性；法拉第和克尔旋转继承了光学电导率的特征。
AI.conclusion: 光学和磁光光谱是探测交错磁体拓扑系统中狄拉克能隙和范霍夫奇点的灵敏探针，尤其横向光导率中的范霍夫特征可作为d波交错磁体特有的光学指纹。

title: First-principles design of main-group dimer defects in ZnO as candidate quantum defects
summary: Zinc oxide (ZnO), a wide-band-gap semiconductor with mature growth techniques, is a promising host for optically active quantum spins. Yet, optically active quantum defects in ZnO remain largely unexplored. Here, we identify and characterize a family of double substitutional impurities in ZnO, formed by main-group donor-acceptor (DA) pairs, as candidates for optically active quantum defects. Using hybrid density functional theory (DFT), we systematically investigate double substitutional DA complexes and their defect physics, including electronic structure, thermodynamic stability, and optical properties. The proposed defects exhibit isolated defect states, strong spin localization on the acceptor site, and $C_{3v}$ symmetry. Importantly, the electronic structure of the DA pairs is largely determined by the atomic properties of their constituent atoms. We further examine their optical characteristics, including zero-phonon lines (ZPLs), radiative lifetimes, and nonradiative decay to assess their viability as color centers. Notably, among the dimers, (Si$_{Zn}$-B$_O$)$^+$ and (Ge$_{Zn}$-B$_O$)$^+$ exhibit visible optical transitions with sub-microsecond radiative lifetimes and robust charge states against optical ionization, while (Si$_{Zn}$-C$_O$)$^{2+}$ shows the smallest Huang-Rhys factor, approximately 5.6. Our results propose a new family of main-group donor-acceptor defects in ZnO as promising candidates for optically active spin defects.

AI.tldr: 本文通过混合密度泛函理论（hybrid DFT）系统研究了ZnO中由主族供体-受体（D-A）对形成的双取代杂质缺陷家族，发现它们具有孤立的缺陷态、强烈的自旋局域化和C₃ᵥ对称性。其中(Si_Zn-B_O)⁺和(Ge_Zn-B_O)⁺展现出可见光光学跃迁、亚微秒辐射寿命和稳健的电荷态，有望成为光活性量子自旋缺陷的候选材料。
AI.motivation: ZnO作为宽带隙半导体具有成熟的生长技术，是光活性量子自旋的良好宿主材料，但其光活性量子缺陷尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统的候选缺陷体系研究。
AI.method: 采用混合密度泛函理论（hybrid DFT）对ZnO中双取代主族供体-受体（D-A）对缺陷进行系统研究，分析其电子结构、热力学稳定性、光学性质（包括零声子线、辐射寿命和非辐射衰减），并评估其作为色心的可行性。
AI.result: 发现D-A对缺陷表现出孤立的缺陷态、强自旋局域化和C₃ᵥ对称性；(Si_Zn-B_O)⁺和(Ge_Zn-B_O)⁺具有可见光跃迁、亚微秒辐射寿命和抗光电离的稳定电荷态；(Si_Zn-C_O)²⁺的Huang-Rhys因子最小（约5.6），表明其具有较小的电子-声子耦合。
AI.conclusion: 提出ZnO中主族供体-受体对缺陷可作为光活性自旋缺陷的新候选家族，其中部分缺陷展现出优良的光学性能和电荷稳定性，为量子技术应用提供了新的材料平台。

title: Electric-Field-Induced Second Harmonic Generation at a Reconfigurable LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ Nanojunction
summary: Electrically tunable nonlinear optical responses at the nanoscale remain challenging to achieve because conventional nonlinear materials lack the combination of large susceptibility, nanoscale confinement, and in situ reconfigurability. Here we report electric-field-induced second harmonic (EFISH) generation from a nanoscale tunnel junction defined by conductive atomic force microscope lithography at the LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ interface. A conducting channel written at the interface is interrupted by a nanoscale insulating gap, across which applied DC bias produces local electric fields exceeding $10^7$ V/m. The SHG signal is spatially localized at the junction, exhibits a quadratic bias dependence described by $I(2ω) \propto |χ^{(2)}_\mathrm{0} + χ^{(3)} E_\mathrm{DC}|^2$ with no hysteresis, a modulation depth exceeding 380% at $|V_\mathrm{DC}| = 1$ V, and shows a two-lobed input-polarization pattern aligned with the junction axis, consistent with EFISH from a centrosymmetric host. Calibration against a BBO reference crystal gives $|χ^{(3)}| \approx 1\times10^{-19}$ m$^2$/V$^2$ at 6 K. These results establish cAFM-written oxide nanojunctions as a reconfigurable platform for nanoscale nonlinear optics in which the junction geometry sets the symmetry of the response and the large field-induced $χ^{(2)}$ of SrTiO$_3$ provides the optical nonlinearity. Because the nonlinearity is both generated and read out within the same nanoscale gap, the junction operates simultaneously as a subwavelength source and a near-field detector of optical nonlinearity.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃界面通过导电原子力显微镜(cAFM)光刻定义的纳米隧道结中实现电场诱导二次谐波(SH)产生。施加直流偏压可在纳米级绝缘间隙中产生超过10⁷ V/m的局域电场，SHG信号在结处空间局域，具有二次偏压依赖、无滞回、380%以上调制深度，并与BBO参考晶体校准得到|χ⁽³⁾|≈1×10⁻¹⁹ m²/V²。该平台可作为可重构的纳米级非线性光学平台。
AI.motivation: 传统非线性材料难以同时满足大非线性极化率、纳米级光场约束和原位可重构性这三个条件，因此实现纳米尺度的可电调非线性光学响应极具挑战性。作者试图寻找一种平台，能在纳米尺度实现电控制非线性光学效应。
AI.method: 利用导电原子力显微镜(cAFM)光刻技术在LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃界面写入导电沟道，并构造一个纳米级绝缘间隙形成隧道结。在结两端施加直流偏压产生强局域电场(>10⁷ V/m)，通过电场诱导的χ⁽²⁾效应产生SHG信号。系统测量SHG的空间分布、偏压依赖关系、偏振特性和调制深度，并用BBO参考晶体进行绝对校准。
AI.result: SHG信号空间局域在纳米结处，呈二次偏压依赖关系I(2ω)∝|χ⁽²⁾₀+χ⁽³⁾EDC|²，无滞回现象，在|VDC|=1 V时调制深度超过380%。输入偏振呈现两瓣图案且与结轴对齐，符合中心对称主体的EFISH特征。校准得到|χ⁽³⁾|≈1×10⁻¹⁹ m²/V²（6 K）。
AI.conclusion: cAFM写入的氧化物纳米结可作为可重构的纳米级非线性光学平台。结的几何结构决定响应对称性，SrTiO₃的大场致χ⁽²⁾提供光学非线性。由于非线性在同一个纳米间隙中被产生和读出，该结同时作为亚波长光源和近场非线性探测器工作。

title: Systematic and accurate anharmonic formation free energies of metastable defects via a constrained Bayesian Adaptive Biasing Force framework
summary: Computing the formation free energies of metastable defects at finite temperature remains challenging due to anharmonicity, the multiplicity of basins and the frequent occurrence of migration events. Using the previously introduced constrained Bayesian Adaptive Biasing Force method (BABFc), we establish a practical thermodynamic integration framework for computing restricted anharmonic formation free energies associated with individual metastable defect basins. We demonstrate that BABFc can be exploited as a robust, systematic and numerically efficient tool for addressing a long standing bottleneck in atomistic materials science: the finite temperature thermodynamic characterization of metastable defects in complex, highly anharmonic energy landscapes. The proposed workflow requires only a reference local minimum and a confinement strategy and does not rely on defect specific collective variables. It therefore provides a general route to assign well-defined free energies to individual metastable basins, even when these basins are separated by low barriers and embedded in a dense landscape of competing configurations. In this setting, BABFc enables stable, bias corrected free energy estimates with statistical accuracies at the meV/atom level and a very low failure rate, including for systems containing approximately one thousand atoms. We demonstrate this capability through thousands of independent free energy calculations covering hundreds of four-interstitial and four-vacancy configurations in bcc $α$-Fe over a broad temperature range, using both a traditional empirical potential and a data driven force field.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于约束贝叶斯自适应偏置力方法（BABFc）的热力学积分框架，用于计算亚稳缺陷在有限温度下的受限非谐形成自由能，并在bcc α-Fe中通过数千次独立计算验证了其鲁棒性和统计精度（meV/atom级别）。
AI.motivation: 有限温度下亚稳缺陷形成自由能的计算长期面临挑战，主要源于非谐效应、势能面多盆地结构以及频繁的迁移事件，传统方法难以系统且高效地处理这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 利用此前提出的约束贝叶斯自适应偏置力方法（BABFc），建立实用的热力学积分框架，计算与单个亚稳缺陷盆地相关的受限非谐形成自由能。该方法仅需参考局部极小值和约束策略，不依赖缺陷特定的集体变量。
AI.result: 该方法在包含约一千个原子的体系中，能够获得meV/atom级别的统计精度和极低的失败率。通过在bcc α-Fe中对数百个四间隙和四空位构型进行数千次独立自由能计算，覆盖广泛温度范围，并使用经验势和数据驱动力场，验证了方法的通用性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: BABFc为在复杂、高度非谐的能量景观中对单个亚稳盆地赋予明确定义的自由能提供了通用途径，即使盆地间势垒较低且处于密集竞争构型中也能稳定工作，填补了原子材料科学中有限温度亚稳缺陷热力学表征的长期空白。

title: An autonomous feedback protocol: responding to temperature and potential changes in energy converters
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures; Supplemental Material 11 pages, 4 figures
summary: Nanoscale thermoelectric devices convert tiny amounts of heat into power. But what happens if the external conditions and resulting temperature differences are not a priori known? We propose a feedback mechanism that optimizes the performance of a quantum-point-contact-based heat engine (QPC). A quantum-dot detector measures the external conditions and gives autonomous feedback on the QPC's properties. We expect this feedback mechanism to be experimentally relevant for steady-state engines with unknown external conditions and for adapting dynamic charging processes to the potential buildup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于量子点探测器的反馈机制，用于优化量子点接触（QPC）热机在外部条件未知情况下的性能。该机制通过量子点探测器自主测量外部条件并反馈调节QPC的性质，使其适应未知的温度梯度和动态充电过程。
AI.motivation: 纳尺度热电设备能将微小热量转化为电能，但实际应用中外部条件和温度差往往是未知的，这限制了热机的优化运行。因此需要一种能够自适应外部未知条件的机制。
AI.method: 提出一种反馈机制：用量子点探测器（quantum-dot detector）实时测量外部条件，并自主反馈调节量子点接触（QPC）的性质参数，从而优化热机性能。
AI.result: 该反馈机制预计对稳态热机在未知外部条件下具有实验相关性，并能适用于适应电势累积的动态充电过程。
AI.conclusion: 该反馈机制有望在实验上实现，使得量子点接触热机能够在未知外部条件下自主优化性能，并为动态充电过程提供自适应调节能力。

title: Broken Inversion Symmetry via a Magic Methyl Effect
summary: Polar liquid crystals - fluid phases in which molecular dipoles organise into ferro- or antiferroelectric states - present a highly constrained molecular design space, where small changes can entirely suppress polar organisation. Here we demonstrate, contrary to expectations, that installation of a methyl group in the 5-position of a 1,3-dioxane ring substantially increases the onset temperature of polar order. Remarkably, this effect proves transferable across several liquid-crystal families, including examples where the methylated derivative exhibits a polar phase whereas its parent compound does not. Across 8 matched pairs, we find that a 5-methyl group can enhance the onset temperature of polar order in 1,3-dioxane materials by up to 120 °C. These findings establish a simple and general molecular design strategy for enhancing and enabling spontaneous dipolar ordering in liquid crystals.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在1,3-二氧六环的5位引入甲基基团可显著提高液晶极性有序的起始温度，这一效应在多个液晶家族中具有普适性，8对匹配化合物中最高可将极性有序起始温度提高120°C，且有些原本无极性相的母体化合物在甲基化后出现极性相，为增强和实现液晶自发偶极有序提供了简单通用的分子设计策略。
AI.motivation: 极性液晶（铁电/反铁电态）的分子设计空间高度受限，微小的结构变化可能完全抑制极性组织，因此亟需寻找一种简单、通用且可预测的分子设计策略来增强或实现液晶中的自发偶极有序。
AI.method: 作者在1,3-二氧六环的5位引入甲基基团，系统考察该修饰对极性有序起始温度的影响，并在多个液晶家族（8对匹配化合物）中验证该效应的可转移性。
AI.result: 5-甲基基团的引入显著提高极性有序起始温度，在8对匹配化合物中最多可提高120°C；在某些情况下，甲基化衍生物表现出极性相而母体化合物不表现，表明该效应具有跨家族的普适性。
AI.conclusion: 在1,3-二氧六环5位安装甲基是一种简单、通用的分子设计策略，可有效增强乃至开启液晶中的自发偶极有序，为极性液晶材料的设计提供了新的方向。

title: Continuously control of polarization via electrically driven long-distance superlubric sliding
summary: Sliding ferroelectricity widely exists in various van der Waals bilayers or multilayers, which is induced by asymmetric stacking of commensurate interface. The greatly reduced switching barriers via interlayer sliding lead to high speed with low energy cost, while they are still much higher compared with superlubric sliding of incommensurate interfaces. The polarizations of such incommensurate interfaces are not switchable, which is the major obstacle of combing superlubricity and sliding ferroelectricity for ultralow barriers. Here we propose a design of such combination based on previous synthesis of lateral heterojunctions of 2D materials, which can be extensively applicable to various systems including PN junctions. In such long-distance superlubric ferroelectricity, the vertical polarization can be continuously controlled by superlubric sliding of incommensurate interfaces between lateral heterojunction bilayers, where the series of multiple stable states are long-sought for artificial synaptic devices. The unconventionality of our findings does not only include unprecedented barriers down to the magnitude of mu-eV, but also unprecedented long ion displacements distinct from the small deviations in classical paradigm of ferroelectricity. Our predicted superlubric sliding electrically driven by low vertical voltage is also hitherto reported, much more efficient compared with previously reported sliding mechanically driven by tips, resolving a major issue for practical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将超润滑滑动与滑动铁电性相结合的设计方案，基于二维材料横向异质结双层结构，实现超低能垒（μeV量级）的连续可调垂直极化，为人工突触器件提供了多稳态平台，并通过低电压电驱动实现超润滑滑动，解决了实际应用中的关键问题。
AI.motivation: 滑动铁电性虽然具有极低的切换势垒和高速低能耗优势，但其势垒仍远高于非公度界面的超润滑滑动；而非公度界面的极化不可切换，成为将超润滑与滑动铁电性结合以实现超低势垒的主要障碍。作者希望打破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 基于先前合成的二维材料横向异质结，构建横向异质结双层之间的非公度界面超润滑滑动体系，使垂直极化可通过超润滑滑动连续调控，形成一系列多稳态；并通过理论预测低垂直电压实现电驱动的超润滑滑动。
AI.result: 实现了前所未有的μeV量级超低切换势垒，以及区别于经典铁电小偏离的长程离子位移；预测了低电压电驱动的超润滑滑动，相比以往尖端机械驱动方式效率大幅提升，可广泛适用于包括PN结在内的多种体系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功将超润滑性与滑动铁电性结合，开创了"长距离超润滑铁电"新范式，兼具超低势垒、连续多态调控和电驱动优势，为人工突触器件等应用提供了全新方案。

title: Scalable Cyclic Olefin Copolymer Encapsulation for High Optical Quality of TMD Monolayers
summary: Monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) combine a direct bandgap, strongly bound excitons, and pronounced second-order optical nonlinearity, which makes them promising materials for ultrathin optoelectronic and nanophotonic devices. However, their optical performance is often degraded by environmental exposure and substrate-induced charge trapping, motivating the development of scalable encapsulation strategies. Here, we investigate spin-coated cyclic olefin copolymer (COC) as a scalable encapsulant for TMDs. Room-temperature and cryogenic optical spectroscopy reveal enhanced photoluminescence and second-harmonic generation, accompanied by excitonic linewidth narrowing and an increased exciton-to-trion ratio. In addition, COC encapsulation induces an excitonic peak splitting and an overall spectral blueshift. First-principles calculations attribute these spectral modifications to local symmetry breaking at the chalcogen interface and macroscopic compressive strain, respectively. These findings establish spin-coated COC as an effective, scalable encapsulation strategy and a potential platform for post-growth excitonic and band-structure engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了旋涂环烯烃共聚物（COC）作为单层过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）的可扩展封装材料。通过室温和低温光谱学实验发现，COC封装能增强光致发光和二次谐波产生，同时使激子线宽变窄并提高激子与三子比。此外，封装还诱导了激子峰劈裂和整体光谱蓝移，第一性原理计算将其归因于硫族界面处的局部对称性破缺和宏观压应变。
AI.motivation: 单层TMD具有直接带隙、强束缚激子和显著二阶光学非线性等优异特性，但其光学性能常因环境暴露和衬底诱导的电荷捕获而退化，因此迫切需要开发可扩展的封装策略来保护和优化这些材料的性能。
AI.method: 采用旋涂COC作为TMD的可扩展封装层，结合室温与低温光学光谱学（光致发光和二次谐波产生）进行表征，并利用第一性原理计算解释光谱变化的物理机制。
AI.result: COC封装增强了光致发光和二次谐波产生，实现激子线宽窄化和激子-三子比增加；同时观察到激子峰劈裂和整体光谱蓝移，计算表明分别源于硫族界面的局部对称性破缺和宏观压应变。
AI.conclusion: 旋涂COC被证实是一种有效且可扩展的TMD封装策略，为后生长激子与能带结构工程提供了潜在平台。

title: Symmetry-Induced Weyl Nodes in Interacting Multi-Terminal Josephson Junctions
summary: We show that an emergent geometric symmetry generates non-trivial topology in quantum-dot-based multi-terminal Josephson junctions. It confines same-spin Andreev bound state crossings to an analytic one-dimensional manifold of the synthetic Brillouin zone, where interdot coupling selects Weyl nodes of charge $\pm1$ in the singlet sector and doubly degenerate cones of charge $\pm2$ in the doublet sector, at gate-tunable locations. The mechanism yields a spectroscopic detection protocol and a design principle for fabricating devices with non-trivial topological signatures.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了量子点基多端约瑟夫森结中涌现的几何对称性如何产生非平凡拓扑。该对称性将同自旋安德烈耶夫束缚态的交叉限制在合成布里渊区的一个解析一维流形上，其中点间耦合在单重态区选择电荷±1的Weyl节点，在二重态区选择电荷±2的双重简并锥，且位置可通过栅极调谐。
AI.motivation: 探索量子点基多端约瑟夫森结中的拓扑现象，寻找一种新的机制来产生非平凡的拓扑结构，并建立光谱检测方案和器件设计原则。
AI.method: 基于涌现的几何对称性分析，将安德烈耶夫束缚态的拓扑性质映射到合成布里渊区，通过研究Weyl节点和双重简并锥的电荷（±1和±2）与位置来表征不同自旋扇区的拓扑结构。
AI.result: 发现单重态扇区存在电荷±1的Weyl节点，二重态扇区存在电荷±2的双重简并锥；这些拓扑特征的位置可通过栅极电压调谐。
AI.conclusion: 该机制提供了光谱检测拓扑特征的新协议，并给出了制造具有非平凡拓扑签名的器件的设计原则，为拓扑量子计算或相关应用提供了可能的新平台。

title: The Continuum Model for Uniaxially Strained Bilayer Graphene Moiré Systems
summary: We construct a continuum model for a one-dimensional moiré superlattice formed by stretching one layer of AB-stacked bilayer graphene along the x direction by a factor s. Following the spirit of the Bistritzer-MacDonald model for twisted bilayer graphene, we treat the interlayer coupling as hopping between several Dirac points. At a critical stretch factor s ~ 1.018 the two bands near the Fermi level touch, forming two degeneracy points along the k_y direction. This gap closing is accompanied by a topological phase transition, in which the Chern number changes from 1 to -1, and by a sign change of the Berry-curvature dipole, which we propose can be detected through the nonlinear Hall effect. We find that uniaxial strain modulates inter-Dirac-valley coupling, which drives band gap collapse and subsequent topological number inversion. This opens a route to engineer topological transport and quantum anomalous Hall effects via strain engineering of moiré heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一维莫尔超晶格的连续模型，该超晶格由AB堆叠双层石墨烯沿x方向拉伸因子s形成。临界拉伸因子s≈1.018时，费米能级附近两带接触形成简并点，伴随Chern数从1变为-1的拓扑相变及Berry曲率偶极子符号翻转，可通过非线性霍尔效应检测。单向应变调节谷间耦合驱动带隙塌缩和拓扑数反转，为莫尔异质结构的应变工程开辟新途径。
AI.motivation: 探索通过应变工程调控莫尔异质结构的拓扑性质，特别是研究单轴应变如何调制谷间耦合并驱动拓扑相变，从而为拓扑输运和量子反常霍尔效应的工程化提供新思路。
AI.method: 构建一维莫尔超晶格连续模型，遵循Bistritzer-MacDonald模型思路，将层间耦合处理为多个狄拉克点之间的跳跃；通过调节拉伸因子s分析能带结构、Chern数和Berry曲率偶极子的变化。
AI.result: 临界拉伸因子s≈1.018时发生带隙闭合，形成沿k_y方向的两个简并点；Chern数从1翻转为-1，Berry曲率偶极子符号改变；该拓扑相变源于单轴应变对谷间耦合的调制。
AI.conclusion: 单轴应变可作为有效调控手段驱动莫尔超晶格拓扑相变，实现拓扑数与Berry曲率偶极子的可控反转，为应变工程实现量子反常霍尔效应和拓扑输运提供可行路径。

title: Identification of the length scale parameter of simplified strain gradient elasticity from standard Mode I fracture tests
summary: Recently, it was shown that additional material constants of strain gradient elasticity (SGE) can be identified for brittle and quasi-brittle materials based on the analysis of experimental data on the crack size effect. In the present paper, we perform precise numerical simulations within SGE and derive regression relations for processing experimental data from standard fracture mechanics tests under pure Mode I loading conditions (CCT, SENT, SENB). We consider the simplified SGE, whose constitutive relations contain a single length scale parameter $\ell$ in addition to the classical elastic constants. We show that, for brittle materials, this parameter can be explicitly identified as $\ell \approx 0.362 (K_{Ic}/σ_{ult})^2$. This identification ensures that the fracture loads predicted by classical linear elastic fracture mechanics (LEFM) and by the simplified SGE coincide for relatively long Mode I cracks. However, within the simplified SGE, these fracture loads are evaluated from the nonsingular stress field using the maximum principal stress criterion. For quasi-brittle materials, we derive regression relations that describe the non-classical size effect on strength. This effect is usually treated within nonlinear fracture mechanics but can be naturally captured by SGE. Examples of identification of the length scale parameter $\ell$ based on the established relations and the experimental data for chopped fiber composites and for porous and dense quasi-brittle ceramics are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文通过精确数值模拟，在简化应变梯度弹性（SGE）框架下推导回归关系，用于处理纯Mode I断裂力学实验数据（CCT、SENT、SENB）。对于脆性材料，明确识别出单一长度尺度参数ℓ ≈ 0.362(K_Ic/σ_ult)²，确保经典线弹性断裂力学（LEFM）与简化SGE预测的断裂载荷一致；对于准脆性材料，推导出描述非经典尺寸效应的回归关系，并基于短切纤维复合材料和多孔/致密准脆性陶瓷的实验数据进行了参数识别验证。
AI.motivation: 传统SGE中的额外材料常数难以从实验中确定，本文旨在建立基于标准断裂力学试验数据的系统识别方法，使SGE能够统一描述脆性和准脆性材料的断裂行为。
AI.method: 在简化SGE框架下（仅含单一长度尺度参数ℓ），对纯Mode I加载条件下的CCT、SENT、SENB标准试样进行精确数值模拟，推导回归关系；采用最大主应力准则从非奇异应力场评估断裂载荷，并利用回归关系结合实验数据识别长度尺度参数ℓ。
AI.result: 对于脆性材料，确定了显式公式ℓ ≈ 0.362(K_Ic/σ_ult)²，使SGE与LEFM在长裂纹下预测一致；对于准脆性材料，推导出量化非经典尺寸效应的回归关系，并在短切纤维复合材料和多种陶瓷的实验数据中成功识别了ℓ参数。
AI.conclusion: 简化SGE能够自然捕获准脆性材料中通常需要非线性断裂力学才能描述的尺寸效应，且通过标准断裂力学试验即可系统识别其长度尺度参数，为SGE的实际工程应用提供了可行的参数标定途径。

title: Soft and chiral phonons in chiral phase of K3NiO2
summary: Raman scattering measurements confirmed the theoretical prediction that the structural phase transition from the achiral tetragonal to the chiral tetragonal phase, which occurs near 400 K, is induced by a doubly degenerate soft phonon at the Z point of the Brillouin zone. In the low-temperature chiral phase, the soft mode activates in Raman spectra, splits into two components with A1 and B1 symmetries and harden with cooling according to Cochran law. Circularly polarized Raman scattering did not reveal the angular momentum of these singly degenerate phonons at the Gamma point, which is consistent with theory. We also calculated the phonon branches in the whole Brillouin zone for both crystalline phases and compared the results with the phonons observable in the Raman spectra. The calculations revealed that some phonons with nonzero k have angular momentum in the chiral phase. A pronounced circular motion of atoms can be observed, for example, in a Dirac-type topological phonon at the M-point of the Brillouin zone with a frequency of 168 cm-1.

AI.tldr: 本文通过拉曼散射实验证实了理论预测：在约400 K附近发生从非手性四方相到手性四方相的结构相变，该相变由布里渊区Z点的双重简并软声子驱动。低温手性相中软模活化并分裂为A1和B1两个分量。全布里渊区声子计算显示手性相中存在携带角动量的声子，例如M点168 cm-1处的狄拉克型拓扑声子表现出显著的原子圆周运动。
AI.motivation: 验证理论预测的结构相变机制，即手性四方相变由Z点软声子驱动，并探究手性相中声子是否携带角动量（手性声子）这一前沿物理问题。
AI.method: 采用拉曼散射（包括圆偏振拉曼散射）测量软声子的温度依赖行为，并结合第一性原理计算全布里渊区声子色散关系，对比实验结果与理论计算。
AI.result: 实验证实Z点双重简并软声子驱动相变；软模在手性相中分裂为A1和B1对称性的两个分量并按Cochran定律随冷却硬化；Γ点单重简并声子未表现出角动量；计算发现手性相中非零k声子具有角动量，如M点168 cm-1的狄拉克型拓扑声子具有明显的原子圆周运动。
AI.conclusion: 手性结构相变由软声子驱动，手性相中非Γ点声子可以携带角动量（手性声子），为拓扑声子和手性声子的研究提供了新的实验与理论依据。

title: Sulfur-rich Spirofluorene-Bridged N Heterotriangulene Redox-Active Polymers
summary: Sulfur-rich spirofluorene-bridged N-heterotriangulene (FTN) polymers featuring covalently linked oligosulfide units and a terthiophene-based analogue were synthesized via nucleophilic aromatic substitution and Stille cross-coupling polymerization. The resulting materials are amorphous, insoluble solids with high thermal stability and sulfur contents up to 25 wt%. Structural and compositional analyses by combustion analysis, ToF-SIMS, FT-IR, XPS, and solid-state NMR confirm the efficient incorporation of short oligosulfide to disulfide linkages and well-defined terthiophene units in the respective polymers. Electrochemical characterization in lithium half-cells reveals a reversible, high-voltage oxidation of the FTN unit at 3.8-4.0 V (vs. Li/Li+), accompanied by low-voltage sulfur- or terthiophene-based redox processes between 1.5-2.5 V (vs. Li/Li+). Sulfur incorporation markedly increases the theoretical and initial discharge capacities (up to 129 mA h g-1), while the sulfide conversion processes exhibit rapid fading and poor reversibility due to sulfide dissolution. In contrast, the terthiophene-linked polymer shows only transient low-voltage activity while maintaining high Coulombic efficiencies (ca. 99.7%) governed by the persistent FTN backbone redox event. Our results highlight how different redox-active linkers influence the electrochemical behavior of FTN-based polymers and provide insights into the design of functional organic cathode materials featuring multi-redox processes.

AI.tldr: 本文合成了硫富集的螺芴桥联N-杂三芴（FTN）聚合物及其三噻吩类似物，通过芳香亲核取代和Stille偶联聚合制备。硫含量高达25 wt%，具有高热稳定性。电化学表征显示FTN单元在3.8-4.0 V发生可逆高电压氧化，而硫或三噻吩在1.5-2.5 V发生低电压氧化还原。硫的引入提高了初始放电容量（最高129 mA h g-1），但因硫化物溶解导致快速衰减；三噻吩连接聚合物则保持高库仑效率（~99.7%），由FTN主链氧化还原主导。
AI.motivation: 探索不同氧化还原活性连接基团（寡硫化物单元与三噻吩）对FTN基有机正极材料电化学行为的影响，为设计具有多氧化还原过程的有机阴极材料提供思路，同时揭示硫化物溶解导致的容量衰减机制。
AI.method: 通过亲核芳香取代和Stille交叉偶联聚合合成硫富集螺芴桥联FTN聚合物及三噻吩类似物；采用燃烧分析、ToF-SIMS、FT-IR、XPS和固态NMR进行结构与组成表征；在锂半电池中进行电化学性能测试。
AI.result: 成功合成了无定形、不溶性、硫含量高达25 wt%的聚合物；FTN单元在3.8-4.0 V表现可逆高电压氧化，硫基低电压氧化还原（1.5-2.5 V）使初始放电容量达129 mA h g-1但快速衰减；三噻吩聚合物保持99.7%的高库仑效率，由FTN主链氧化还原主导。
AI.conclusion: 不同氧化还原活性连接基团显著影响FTN基聚合物的电化学行为：硫化物连接提高容量但因溶解导致差的循环稳定性，而三噻吩连接提供稳定的主链氧化还原和优异库仑效率。这为设计多氧化还原有机正极材料提供了重要设计指导。

title: Symmetry-engineering ferroelectricity in silicon dioxides
summary: It is a long-established rule for classical ferroelectricity that any ferroelectric crystal must adopt one of the 10 specific polar point groups. Here we predict a unique type of ferroelectricity that can be generated in some crystals belonging to nonpolar noncentrosymmetric groups. This principle can be applicable to many systems including silicon dioxides, the most widely used dielectric materials. Most of their crystalline phases do not belong the polar groups, while the nonlinear Si-O-Si configurations lead to multiple identical states. We show first-principles evidence that the crystal symmetry forbidding the formation of polarizations, can be broken by either parallel surfaces in thin-films or applying a uniaxial strain. As a result, the multiple identical states are endowed with polarizations of different directions, and low-barrier ferroelectric switching can be realized via transition between them, which can be room-temperature robust down to the thickness of 1 nm. Our findings may not only enable low-cost and large-scale manufacture of ferroelectrics directly integrated in silicon chips, but also open a new avenue for exploring ferroelectricity in prevalent nonpolar materials.

AI.tldr: 本文预测了一种新型铁电性，可在属于非极性非中心对称点群的晶体中产生，打破了传统铁电体必须属于10个极性点群的规则。该原理适用于二氧化硅等常见介电材料，通过薄膜平行表面或单轴应变打破对称性，实现不同方向极化态之间的低势垒铁电切换，室温下可稳定至1纳米厚度。
AI.motivation: 传统铁电理论认为铁电晶体必须属于10个极性点群，这限制了铁电材料的选择范围。作者旨在探索非极性材料中产生铁电性的可能性，以扩展铁电材料家族并实现与硅芯片的低成本大规模集成。
AI.method: 作者提出通过非线性Si-O-Si构型产生多个等同态，利用第一性原理计算，证明可通过薄膜中的平行表面或施加单轴应变来打破晶体对称性（该对称性原本禁止极化形成），从而赋予等同态不同方向的极化，实现铁电切换。
AI.result: 第一性原理证据表明，非极性非中心对称晶体可通过表面或应变工程获得铁电性；铁电切换具有低势垒，在室温下可稳定至1纳米厚度。
AI.conclusion: 该发现不仅为直接在硅芯片中低成本大规模制造铁电体铺平道路，还为在普遍存在的非极性材料中探索铁电性开辟了新途径。

title: Chemical Control of Electronic Structure and Topology in Tellurium-Encapsulated Silicene
summary: We investigate chemical control of the electronic, optical, and topological properties of two-dimensional \ce{Si2X2Te2} (\ce{X} = \ce{B}, \ce{Al}, \ce{Ga}, and \ce{In}) monolayers using first-principles calculations. All compounds are dynamically stable semiconductors, with their vibrational and electronic properties evolving systematically upon group-III substitution. Hybrid-functional calculations including spin--orbit coupling reveal predominantly $p$-orbital band edges and increasingly pronounced relativistic effects from B to In. Most notably, the calculated $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariant identifies \ce{Si2In2Te2} as a candidate quantum spin Hall insulator, while the B-, Al-, and Ga-based monolayers remain topologically trivial. Bethe--Salpeter calculations further show that electron--hole interactions redistribute oscillator strength near the absorption onset while preserving a weak in-plane optical anisotropy. Our results establish group-III substitution as a simple chemical route to tune the electronic structure and drive a transition from trivial to nontrivial topology in \ce{Si2X2Te2} monolayers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了二维Si2X2Te2（X=B, Al, Ga, In）单层材料的电子、光学和拓扑性质，发现In基单层是量子自旋霍尔绝缘体候选材料，而B、Al、Ga基单层保持拓扑平庸，证实了第三主族取代可作为调控电子结构和拓扑相变的化学途径。
AI.motivation: 探索通过化学取代（第三主族元素替代）来调控二维材料的电子结构、光学性质和拓扑性质，寻找量子自旋霍尔绝缘体候选材料，为二维拓扑材料的化学设计提供新思路。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，包括杂化泛函计算并加入自旋轨道耦合效应；通过声子计算验证动力学稳定性；计算Z2拓扑不变量判定拓扑性质；使用Bethe-Salpeter方程计算激子效应对光学性质的影响。
AI.result: 所有化合物均为动力学稳定的半导体，振动和电子性质随第三主族取代系统演化；能带边以p轨道为主，从B到In相对论效应逐渐增强；Si2In2Te2被识别为量子自旋霍尔绝缘体候选材料，而B、Al、Ga基单层保持拓扑平庸；电子-空穴相互作用在吸收边附近重新分配振子强度，但保持弱的面内光学各向异性。
AI.conclusion: 第三主族取代是一种简单有效的化学手段，可调控Si2X2Te2单层材料的电子结构，并驱动从平庸到非平庸拓扑的相变，为设计二维拓扑绝缘体提供了可行的化学合成策略。

title: Dirac Surface States and Nonlocal Quantum Tunneling in Topological Semiconductor Mo$_2$SeTe$_3$ for High-Performance Tunnel FETs
summary: A first-principles and device-level study of the quasi-two-dimensional transition-metal chalcogenide Mo$_2$SeTe$_3$ is performed. The material is found to be a weak topological semiconductor with a finite bulk band gap and symmetry-protected Dirac surface states, indicating strong potential for next-generation low-power quantum electronic devices. An SOC-driven band inversion accompanied by an indirect semiconducting gap of approximately 0.75 eV is observed. Topological nontriviality is rigorously confirmed through Wannier charge-center evolution and $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariant analysis, yielding weak topological indices of $(0;001)$, while iterative Green's-function surface-state calculations corroborate Dirac-cone conducting states traversing the bulk gap on symmetry-preserving surfaces. Mo$_2$SeTe$_3$ additionally exhibits exceptional dynamical and mechanical stability, pronounced optical anisotropy, high dielectric polarizability, broad infrared-to-visible optical absorption, a large static dielectric constant, and substantial birefringence, making it favorable for photonic and optoelectronic applications. Thermoelectric transport analyses further reveal enhanced carrier mobility and a competitive figure of merit under $n$-type doping near room temperature. A dual-source tunnel field-effect transistor (TFET) is implemented via TCAD simulations with nonlocal band-to-band tunneling, yielding subthreshold switching below the thermionic limit, a high ON/OFF current ratio, and enhanced tunneling efficiency driven by SOC-induced orbital hybridization and topologically enhanced interband coupling. The concurrent realization of nontrivial bulk-boundary correspondence, robust transport properties, and steep-slope switching characteristics establishes Mo$_2$SeTe$_3$ as a multifunctional quantum material platform for topological and next-generation energy-efficient nanoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理和器件级模拟，系统研究了准二维过渡金属硫族化合物Mo₂SeTe₃，发现其是一种弱拓扑半导体，具有有限体带隙和对称保护的Dirac表面态。材料展现出优异的光学各向异性、高介电极化率、宽光谱吸收和竞争性热电性能。基于TCAD模拟实现的双源隧穿场效应晶体管展现出亚热电子限幅的陡峭开关特性和高开关比，确立了该材料作为多功能量子材料平台的地位。
AI.motivation: 寻找兼具拓扑非平凡性、优异光电子性能和低功耗开关特性的多功能量子材料，以满足下一代低功耗量子电子器件和能源高效纳米电子器件的需求。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（DFT）研究电子结构；通过Wannier电荷中心演化和Z₂不变量分析确认拓扑性质；使用迭代Green函数方法计算表面态；结合非局部带间隧穿模型进行TCAD器件模拟，实现双源TFET。
AI.result: Mo₂SeTe₃被确定为弱拓扑半导体（拓扑指数(0;001)），间接带隙约0.75 eV，具有对称保护的Dirac表面态。材料展现出优异的动力学和力学稳定性、显著光学各向异性、宽红外至可见光吸收、大静态介电常数和双折射。TCAD模拟的双源TFET实现了低于热电子限幅的亚阈值摆幅、高ON/OFF比和增强的隧穿效率。
AI.conclusion: Mo₂SeTe₃同时实现了非平凡体-边界对应、稳健的输运特性和陡峭开关特性，确立了其作为多功能量子材料平台的地位，适用于拓扑学和下一代能量高效纳米电子器件。
